Acidic Poison Cloud Trap.name: Trampa de nube venenosa acida
Acidic Poison Cloud Trap.description: Cinco boquillas ocultas en el techo del apartamento expulsan densas nubes de veneno acido desde un deposito reforzado tras la pared.
Acidic Poison Cloud Trap.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:35|name:Block One Nozzle|traits:action:disable-a-device] (experto) para bloquear una de las boquillas o @Check[thievery|dc:40|name:Shut Off the Tank|traits:action:disable-a-device] (maestro) para cerrar el tanque. La trampa se desactiva despues de 5 asaltos, cuando el tanque se vacia.
Acidic Poison Cloud Trap.hpDetails: para destruir una boquilla; Dureza del tanque 20; PG del tanque 100 (UR 50) para danar el tanque lo suficiente como para impedir que expulse gas
Acidic Poison Cloud Trap.routine: (1 accion) Cuando se desencadena, la trampa tiene cinco boquillas activas, pero al final de su turno en cada asalto se desactiva una boquilla aleatoria. En el turno de la trampa, las boquillas activas emiten una nube de gas venenoso acido que se expande hasta llenar el apartamento. La nube inflige @Damage[1d6[acid]] de daño y @Damage[1d6[poison]] de daño por cada boquilla activa a cada criatura y objeto en la sala (@Check[fortitude|dc:33|basic|name:Spew Cloud|traits:poison] salvacion). Los objetos desatendidos fallan automaticamente las salvaciones para evitar el daño.

action->Displacement.name: Desplazamiento
action->Displacement.description:
Un astradaemon curva la luz y parece desplazado de su posicion real, aunque permanece en el mismo espacio.

Las criaturas que tengan como objetivo al astradaemon deben intentar una @Check[flat|dc:11] prueba plana, como si el astradaemon estuviera escondido, aunque siga observado.

Los efectos como la dote @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.y2XeMe1F18lIyo59]{Lucha a ciegas} y los @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.ancestryfeatures.Item.y1EmCv2cEb5hXBwx]{Ojos agudos} de los medianos que se aplican a la prueba plana contra criaturas escondidas tambien se aplican contra un astradaemon desplazado.

action->Soul Siphon.name: Sifon de almas
action->Soul Siphon.description:
30 pies. Un astradaemon extrae poder de las almas de los recien asesinados. Si una criatura viva Pequena o mayor muere dentro de su aura, el astradaemon obtiene 5 Puntos de Golpe temporales y un bonificador de estado +1 a las tiradas de ataque y de daño durante 1 asalto, salvo que la criatura haya sido asesinada por la aptitud Devorar alma de un astradaemon.

Los muertos vivientes incorporales y los espiritus vivos que viajan fuera del cuerpo sufren @Damage[1d8[force]] de daño cada asalto dentro del aura del daemon por la presion espiritual mientras el astradaemon atrae fragmentos de sus almas.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.SjrM6XVTLySToS12]{Efecto: Sifon de almas}

action->Essence Drain.name: Essence Drain
action->Essence Drain.description:
Cuando un astradaemon impacta con su garra, fauces o cola, drena las esencias espirituales y vitales del objetivo.

El objetivo sufre @Damage[2d10[void]] de daño y el astradaemon recupera la misma cantidad de Puntos de Golpe. El objetivo debe tener exito en una @Check[fortitude|dc:37|traits:damaging-effect] salvacion or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Condenado 1} y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 1}.

Si el objetivo ya estaba drenado o condenado, en su lugar aumenta el valor de ambas condiciones en 1, hasta un maximo de 4.

action->Mortal Shell.name: Mortal Shell
action->Mortal Shell.description:
Requisitos El astradaemon ha matado a una criatura Grande o menor con Usurpar alma en las ultimas 24 horas y esa criatura esta al alcance del daemon.

Efecto El astradaemon toma y viste el cuerpo de su victima. Esto crea automaticamente un disfraz que permite al astradaemon Hacerse pasar por la criatura objetivo. El cuerpo tiene una cantidad de Puntos de Golpe igual a 3 veces el nivel de la criatura. Cualquier daño dirigido al astradaemon dana primero el cuerpo. Cuando el cuerpo queda reducido a 0 Puntos de Golpe, se destruye y expulsa al astradaemon, devolviendolo a su forma normal de daemon. Si el astradaemon sufre cualquier daño de espiritu mientras viste el cuerpo, el daño se aplica directamente al astradaemon y debe tener exito en una @Check[flat|dc:5] prueba plana o ser expulsado del cuerpo. Ademas, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ihbRf964JDXztcy3]{Disyuncion} y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Disipar magia} pueden expulsar al astradaemon del cuerpo con una prueba de contrarrestar con exito contra CD 41.

Mientras lleva el disfraz, los ataques del astradaemon usan el alcance del cuerpo que habita, y su tamano cambia para coincidir con el de la criatura cuya alma consumio. Ademas, el astradaemon queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 2} y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 4} mientras lleva el disfraz. Estos penalizadores no se han incorporado a este bloque de estadisticas.

action->Smoke Vision.description: El humo no perjudica la vision de un agradaemon; ignora la condicion oculto causada por el humo.

action->Choking Smog.name: Bruma asfixiante
action->Choking Smog.description: 100 pies. El agradaemon esta rodeado de humo ceniciento. Las criaturas dentro del aura estan ocultas, y las criaturas fuera de ella estan ocultas para las criaturas que estan dentro. Las criaturas que no sean daemons no pueden respirar dentro del aura y deben aguantar la respiracion o asfixiarse.

action->Daemonic Pledge.name: Daemonic Pledge
action->Daemonic Pledge.description:
Frecuencia una vez al dia

Efecto El agradaemon designa a un unico mortal voluntario como fanatico juramentado. Esa criatura obtiene resistencia al fuego igual a su nivel, inmunidad al aura de smog asfixiante del agradaemon y vision en humo.

El agradaemon puede tener hasta 10 fanaticos juramentados a la vez y puede retirar ese estado a cualquier numero de fanaticos juramentados como accion gratuita con el rasgo concentracion. El estado tambien puede retirarse con un ritual de @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Expiacion}.

action->Proven Devotion.name: Proven Devotion
action->Proven Devotion.description:
El agradaemon recupera @Damage[15[untyped]] Puntos de Golpe, y un fanatico juramentado a eleccion del agradaemon que este pueda ver pierde 15 Puntos de Golpe (no se aplica ningun efecto que reduzca esta perdida de Puntos de Golpe).

Una criatura juramentada que muere de este modo explota e inflige @Damage[9d10[fire]|options:area-damage] de daño en una @Template[emanation|distance:20] (@Check[reflex|dc:41|basic|options:area-effect] salvacion).

Los efectos completos de la bomba afectan a las criaturas en todos los espacios a 15 pies o menos del horror alquimico, y el daño de salpicadura afecta a las criaturas 5 pies mas alla de esa distancia.

Activar A Golpe

El fuego de alquimista es una combinacion de liquidos volatiles que se inflaman al entrar en contacto con el aire. El fuego de alquimista inflige 2d8 de daño de fuego, 2 de daño persistente de fuego y 2 de daño de salpicadura de fuego. Obtienes un bonificador por objeto +1 a las tiradas de ataque.

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.evBPzM1VsuYcoenn]

Activar 1 Golpe

Una bolsa enredadora esta llena de sustancias pegajosas. Cuando impactas a una criatura con una bolsa enredadora, esa criatura sufre un penalizador de estado -15 pies a sus Velocidades durante 1 minuto. Obtienes un bonificador por objeto +1 a las tiradas de ataque, y la CD para Escapar es 19.

Con un impacto critico, una criatura en contacto con una superficie solida queda pegada a ella y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizada} durante 1 asalto, y una criatura que vuele con alas queda con las alas enredadas, haciendo que caiga al suelo sin sufrir daño y no pueda Volar de nuevo durante 1 asalto. Las bolsas enredadoras no son eficaces contra una criatura que esta en el agua.

El objetivo puede terminar cualquier efecto Escapando o gastando un total de 3 acciones para retirar cuidadosamente las sustancias pegajosas. Estas acciones de Interactuar no tienen que ser consecutivas, y otras criaturas tambien pueden aportar acciones.

equipment->Alchemist Goggles.description:
Estas gafas de laton estan grabadas con motivos de llamas y tienen lentes gruesas y pesadas.

Mientras las llevas, te dan un bonificador por objeto +1 a las pruebas de Artesania para Fabricar objetos alquimicos y un bonificador por objeto +1 a las tiradas de ataque con bombas alquimicas.

Tambien puedes ignorar cobertura menor al realizar Golpes con bombas alquimicas.

equipment->Alchemist's Tools.name: alquimista's Tools
equipment->Alchemist's Tools.description: Esta coleccion portatil de viales y productos quimicos puede usarse para tareas alquimicas sencillas.

equipment->Formula Book.name: Libro de fórmulas
equipment->Formula Book.description:
Un libro de formulas contiene las formulas necesarias para fabricar objetos distintos del equipo comun de este capitulo; los alquimistas suelen recibir uno gratis. Cada libro de formulas puede contener hasta 100 formulas diferentes. Las formulas tambien pueden aparecer en hojas de pergamino, tablillas y casi cualquier otro soporte; no necesitas copiarlas en un libro concreto mientras puedas tenerlas a mano para consultarlas.

Contiene formulas para lo siguiente:

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.WL4O32qFifxnMj0H]{Wyvern Poison}

action->Infused Items.name: Infused Items
action->Infused Items.description: Japu carries el following infused objetos, que last 24 horas o hasta la proxima vez el makes su daily preparations: infused moderado acido flasks (2), infused moderado alchemist's fires (2), moderado elixirs de life (2), infused reagents (6), infused moderado tanglefoot bags (2).

action->Alchemical Formulas (10th).name: Alchemical Formulas (10th)
action->Alchemical Formulas (10th).description: moderado acido flask, moderado alchemist's fuego, mayor antidote, moderado bravo's brew, moderado elixir de life, moderado tanglefoot bag, wyvern veneno

action->Expanded Splash.name: Salpicadura Extendida
action->Expanded Splash.description: Las bombas de Japu que tienen el rasgo salpicadura infligen 5 de daño de salpicadura y salpican hasta 10 pies.

action->Quick Alchemy.name: Alquimia rapida
action->Quick Alchemy.description:

action->Quick Bomber.name: Bombardero rapido
action->Quick Bomber.description: Japu Interactua para sacar una bomba y luego realiza un Golpe con ella.

Almiraj.name: Almiraj
Almiraj.saveDetails: -2 de estado a las salvaciones contra ocultismo

action->Magic Susceptibility.name: Magic Susceptibility
action->Magic Susceptibility.description:
Un almiraj sufre un penalizador de estado -2 a las tiradas de salvacion contra conjuros ocultistas.

Cualquier conjuro ocultista beneficioso con una duracion de 1 asalto o mas lanzado sobre el almiraj dura el doble.

action->Magic Horn.name: Magic Horn
action->Magic Horn.description:
Cualquier criatura viva abatida por el Golpe de cuerno del almiraj queda inmediatamente @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrificada} sin tirada de salvacion, ademas de morir.

Un cuerno de almiraj cercenado conserva un rastro de su antigua magia; en combate, el cuerno puede empunarse como una @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.rQWaJhI5Bko5x14Z]{Daga} +1 o, si se fija a un asta, como una @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.tOhoGvmCMw4JpWcS]{Lanza} +1

El relampago embotellado contiene reactivos volatiles que crean una descarga de electricidad al exponerse al aire. El relampago embotellado inflige 2d6 de daño de electricidad y 2 de daño de salpicadura de electricidad. Con un impacto, el objetivo queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} hasta el comienzo de tu siguiente turno. Obtienes un bonificador por objeto +1 a las tiradas de ataque.

Los reactivos liquidos de este vial absorben rapidamente el calor al exponerse al aire. Un vial de escarcha inflige el daño de frio y el daño de salpicadura de frio indicados. Con un impacto, el objetivo sufre un penalizador de estado a sus Velocidades hasta el final de su siguiente turno. action->Prickly Defense.description:
El avarek se repliega bajo sus espinas, mostrando un exterior defensivo y erizado. Obtiene un bonificador por circunstancia +2 a sus Golpes de espina y a la CA. action->Rolling Assault.name: Rolling Assault
action->Rolling Assault.description:
El avarek se enrosca formando una bola y rueda rapidamente, ensartando enemigos con sus espinas. El avarek Zancajea dos veces y realiza hasta dos Golpes de espina en cualquier punto de su movimiento, cada uno contra un objetivo diferente a su alcance.

action->Wail of the Betrayed.name: Lamento de los traicionados
action->Wail of the Betrayed.description:
Avsheros lanza un lamento agonico que invoca pena y una sensacion de traicion en quienes lo oyen.

Todas las criaturas a 120 pies o menos deben tener exito en una salvacion de @Check[will|dc:47] o quedan @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustadas 2}. Una criatura asustada de este modo no puede aceptar voluntariamente ayuda de ningun tipo de un aliado hasta que se retire la condicion asustado.

Con una salvacion con exito, la criatura es inmune al Lamento de los traicionados de Avsheros durante 24 horas.

Baatamidar.publicNotes: Los baatamidars se sienten atraidos por destruir comunidades planares en los margenes donde los Planos Exteriores tocan el caos del Maelstrom. Parecen masas flotantes de cieno prismatico y ondulante, con cuatro tentaculos temblorosos y gotas de baba aceitosa que siempre gotean hacia arriba.

1 mile. Las criaturas que comiencen su turno en el aura deben tener exito en una salvacion de @Check[will|dc:48|traits:incapacitation] o se vuelven incapaces de entender cualquier comunicacion (incluida la telepatia), distinguir rango social o autoridad, o diferenciar el valor relativo de objetos o servicios. Esto persiste mientras la criatura permanezca en el aura.

Las criaturas que tienen exito en la salvacion quedan temporalmente inmunes durante 1 hora (24 horas con un exito critico). Los proteanos son inmunes al campo de irrelatividad.

El baatamidar puede suprimir esta aura o volver a activarla como accion gratuita.

action->Mind-Numbing Grasp.name: Mind-Numbing Grasp
action->Mind-Numbing Grasp.description:
Los tentaculos del baatamidar drenan el pensamiento. Una criatura que comienza su turno apresada por el baatamidar debe intentar una salvacion de @Check[will|dc:41|traits:arcane,enchantment,incapacitation,mental].

Exito critico Sin efecto.

Exito @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1} durante 1 asalto.

Fallo @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 3} durante 1 minuto.

Fallo critico @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 4} durante 1 minuto.

action->Writhing Arms.name: Writhing Arms
action->Writhing Arms.description:
El baatamidar realiza hasta cuatro Golpes de tentaculo, cada uno contra un objetivo diferente. Cada ataque cuenta por separado para el penalizador por ataques multiples del baatamidar, pero el penalizador no aumenta hasta que el baatamidar haya realizado todos los ataques.

Si despues el baatamidar usa la accion AGARRAR mejorada, puede AGARRAR a cualquier numero de criaturas a las que haya impactado con Brazos retorcidos.

action->Tear Flesh.name: Tear Flesh
action->Tear Flesh.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura apresada por el ghoul percebe falla criticamente una prueba de habilidad para Escapar.

Efecto El ghoul percebe realiza un Golpe de garra contra la criatura desencadenante.

action->Consume Flesh.name: Consumir carne
action->Consume Flesh.description:
Requisitos El ghoul percebe esta adyacente al cadaver de una criatura que murio en la ultima hora.

Efecto El ghoul percebe devora un trozo del cadaver y recupera @Damage[5d6[healing]] Puntos de Golpe.

Solo puede recuperar Puntos de Golpe de un cadaver determinado una vez.

action->Fill Lungs.name: Fill Lungs
action->Fill Lungs.description:
Tirada de salvacion @Check[fortitude|dc:26]

Etapa 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1} (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 2} (1 asalto)

Etapa 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 3} (1 asalto)

Etapa 4 ahogandose y no puede reducirse por debajo de etapa 4 hasta que se retire el agua de sus pulmones.

action->Nimble Swim.name: Nimble Swim
action->Nimble Swim.description: El ghoul percebe Nada hasta 20 pies. Este movimiento no desencadena reacciones.

action->Paralysis.name: Paralysis
action->Paralysis.description:
Cualquier criatura viva que no sea elfa impactada por el ataque de un ghoul debe tener exito en una salvacion de @Check[fortitude|dc:26] o queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizada}.

Puede intentar una nueva salvacion al final de cada uno de sus turnos, y la CD disminuye acumulativamente en 1 con cada salvacion de este tipo.

action->Integrated Launcher.name: Integrated Launcher
action->Integrated Launcher.description: Un lanzaproyectiles esta integrado en los sistemas de un asesino mecanico, con 10 hojas giratorias y cinco bombas de humo. Cuando el asesino es destruido, el lanzador y su municion tambien son destruidos.

action->Smoke Vision.name: Vision entre humo
action->Smoke Vision.description: El humo no perjudica la vision de un agradaemon; ignora la condicion oculto causada por el humo.

action->Wind-Up.name: Wind-Up
action->Wind-Up.description: Para que el asesino mecanico actue, otra criatura debe darle cuerda con una llave unica. Esto requiere 1 minuto. Una vez activado, permanece operativo durante 24 horas; pasado ese tiempo, deja de percibir su entorno y no puede actuar hasta que se le de cuerda de nuevo. El asesino puede entrar en modo de espera como una actividad de 3 acciones. Su tiempo operativo no disminuye mientras esta en espera, pero puede percibir su entorno (con un penalizador -2 a Percepcion). No puede actuar, con una excepcion: cuando percibe que una criatura entra en su alcance, puede salir del modo de espera como reaccion.

action->Poison Ink.name: Poison Ink
action->Poison Ink.description:
Tirada de salvacion @Check[fortitude|dc:38]

Duración máxima 10 asaltos

Etapa 1 @Damage[3d6[poison]] daño y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1} (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 @Damage[4d6[poison]] daño y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 2} (1 asalto).

action->Rapid Repair.name: Rapid Repair
action->Rapid Repair.description: El asesino mecanico gasta 1 hora de su tiempo operativo para REPARARSE, recuperando 25 Puntos de Golpe y recargando su lanzador de proyectiles integrado con 4 hojas giratorias (hasta un maximo de 10) y 2 bombas de humo (hasta un maximo de 5).

action->Smoke Bomb Launcher.name: Smoke Bomb Launcher
action->Smoke Bomb Launcher.description: El asesino mecanico lanza una bomba de humo. Una pantalla de humo espeso y opaco llena una @Template[burst|distance:10] a 60 pies o menos del asesino mecanico. Las criaturas dentro del area estan ocultas, y todas las demas criaturas estan ocultas para ellas. El humo dura 1 minuto o hasta que lo disperse un viento fuerte.

action->Unbalancing Blow.description: Las criaturas impactadas por el Golpe de estoque de repeticion del asesino mecanico quedan @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenidas} hasta el comienzo del siguiente turno del asesino mecanico.

action->Haphazard Hack.name: Haphazard Hack
action->Haphazard Hack.description:
Requisitos Rekarek esta adyacente a dos o mas enemigos.

Efecto Rekarek realiza tres Golpes cuerpo a cuerpo con arma, dos de los cuales deben ser contra enemigos diferentes.

Estos ataques cuentan para su penalizador por ataques multiples, pero solo despues de que se hayan realizado los tres Golpes.

Despues de realizar esta actividad, Rekarek queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenida} hasta el comienzo de su siguiente turno.

action->Delay Condition.name: Delay Condition
action->Delay Condition.description: The binumir's dual spirit takes longer to be affected by detrimental effects. When the binumir is el objetivo of an effect that imparts the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confundido}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlado}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinado}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido} condicion, the condicion is automatically suppressed hasta el final de the binumir's next turn.

action->Agonizing Wail.name: Agonizing Wail
action->Agonizing Wail.description:
El binumir libera un grito angustioso que llena a otros de una tristeza desgarradora. Las criaturas a 30 pies o menos deben intentar una salvacion de @Check[will|dc:17].

Exito critico El objetivo no se ve afectado y queda temporalmente inmune a Lamento agonizante durante 1 minuto.

Exito El objetivo no puede usar reacciones durante 1 asalto.

Fallo El objetivo queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} y no puede usar reacciones durante 1 asalto.

Fallo critico Como fallo, pero el objetivo queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} durante 1 minuto.

action->Dual Assault.description:

Desencadenante Una criatura al alcance del monstruo usa una accion de manipular o una accion de movimiento, realiza un ataque a distancia o abandona una casilla durante una accion de movimiento que esta usando.

Efecto El monstruo intenta un Golpe cuerpo a cuerpo contra la criatura desencadenante. Si el ataque es un impacto critico y el desencadenante fue una accion de manipular, el monstruo interrumpe esa accion. Este Golpe no cuenta para el penalizador por ataques multiples del monstruo, y su penalizador por ataques multiples no se aplica a este Golpe.

action->Brutish Shove.description:

Si impactas a un objetivo de tu tamano o menor, esa criatura queda desprevenida hasta el final de tu turno actual y puedes Empujarla automaticamente, con los mismos beneficios que la accion Empujar (incluido el efecto de exito critico, si tu Golpe fue un impacto critico). Si te mueves para seguir al objetivo, tu movimiento no desencadena reacciones. Este Golpe tiene el siguiente efecto de fallo.

Fallo El objetivo queda desprevenido hasta el final de tu turno actual.

Activar 1 Golpe

Una bolsa enredadora esta llena de sustancias pegajosas. Cuando impactas a una criatura con una bolsa enredadora, esa criatura sufre un penalizador de estado -15 pies a sus Velocidades durante 1 minuto. Obtienes un bonificador por objeto +1 a las tiradas de ataque, y la CD para Escapar es 19.

Las bolsas enredadoras no son eficaces contra una criatura que esta en el agua.

El objetivo puede terminar cualquier efecto Escapando o gastando un total de 3 acciones para retirar cuidadosamente las sustancias pegajosas. Estas acciones de Interactuar no tienen que ser consecutivas, y otras criaturas tambien pueden aportar acciones.

Patrones místicos crean un depósito mágico dentro de esta munición. Activas spellstrike ammunition by Lanzando un conjuro into the ammunition. The conjuro must be of a conjuro rank the ammunition can hold, y the conjuro must be able to target a criatura other than the caster. The ammunition affects only el objetivo hit, even if the conjuro would normally affect more than one target. If the conjuro requires a conjuro tirada de ataque, use the result of tu ranged tirada de ataque with the ammunition to determine the degree of success of the conjuro. If the conjuro requires a tirada de salvacion, el objetivo attempts the save against tu conjuro DC.

The maximum rank of conjuro the ammunition can hold determines its item level y Price.

Puedes use an Interactuar action to pull a set of thieves' tools from the ring. Estos tools appear in tu mano y fold back into the ring if they would leave tu posesion.

They grant tu a +3 bonificador por objeto to THIEVERY checks to Disable a Device y to PICK A LOCK, y the ring's insights grant tu the same bonus a las pruebas de Artesania to Craft y REPAIR snares y traps.

action->Illusory Copies.name: Illusory Copies
action->Illusory Copies.description:
Frecuencia una vez al dia

Efecto Blune calls into existence [[/r 1d4+2 #illusory copies]] illusory copies of himself, which dance around him y copy his every movement, making it almost impossible to pinpoint the true Blune.

Any attack that would hit Blune has a random chance of hitting an illusory copy instead. Este effect lasts for up to 1 minuto or until all the copies are destroyed or Blune is incapacitated.

Once a copy is hit, it's destroyed. If an tirada de ataque fails to hit Blune's AC but doesn't critically fail, it destroys a copy but has no additional effect (even if the attack would normally have an effect on a failure). If an tirada de ataque is a critical success y would hit a copy, the copy is destroyed y the tirada de ataque becomes a success against Blune.

Once all the copies are destroyed, this ability ends.

action->Ferocious Devotion.name: Ferocious Devotion
action->Ferocious Devotion.description:
Cuando un illusory toady es destruido, ello dissolves into un puddle de cerulean quintessence before reforming a quasi-life once more. One asalto after ello es destruido, el toady starts re-forming. One asalto after que, el toady es completely healed y begins a fight once more.

Si damaged mientras ello es re-forming but before el process es complete, el toady es destruido but splits into two cerulean puddles que begin re-forming into two identical toadies 1 asalto later, cada con half el maximum PG de el original toady (este es similar a un @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.uQBOJfjtzEXvpLQz]{Ochre Jelly's} Split ability); el toadies begin re-forming 1 asalto later.

El toadies son permanently destruido solo by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ihbRf964JDXztcy3]{Disjunction} o si @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.agents-of-edgewatch-bestiary.Actor.sUrJ7jxzBiJTbwVo]{Blune} cae unconscious.

action->Amplify Spell.name: Amplify Spell
action->Amplify Spell.description:
The toady wills itself to become a conduit for Blune's next conjuro, empowering the conjuro.

The toady becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizado} until the beginning of its next turn.

If Blune Bandersworth is a 30 pies o menos y Casts a Spell before the toady's next turn, the conjuro travels through the toady before redirecting toward its intended target.

The conjuro is heightened by 1 rank, to a maximum of 10th rank. The toady is then destroyed.

Boiling Fountains.description: Cuatro placas de presion bajo las tablas del suelo activan fuentes con cabeza de dragon a ambos lados de la sala, que rocian agua hirviendo por el area entre ellas.
Boiling Fountains.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:21|name:Disable Pressure Plate|traits:action:disable-a-device] (entrenado) para desactivar cada placa de presion, @Check[thievery|dc:16|name:Jam Fountain|traits:action:disable-a-device] para atascar cada fuente, o @Check[thievery|dc:18|name:Deflect Fountain's Spray|traits:action:disable-a-device] para desviar el chorro de una fuente.

Efecto Las fuentes rocian agua hirviendo a traves de sus propias casillas y del area de 10 pies por 20 pies entre ellas (marcada con lineas punteadas), infligiendo @Damage[(4d6+4)[fire]|options:area-damage] de daño a cualquier criatura en el area (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic|options:area-effect] salvacion).

Boiling Fountains.publicNotes: Cuatro placas de presion bajo las tablas del suelo activan fuentes con cabeza de dragon a ambos lados de la sala, que rocian agua hirviendo por toda la zona entre ellas.

Todas las criaturas en una @Template[cone|distance:5] al este de la trampa de tina hirviente desencadenada sufren @Damage[3d6[persistent,acid],(3[splash])[acid],(8d6+20)[fire]]{3d6 de daño persistente de acido, 3 de daño de salpicadura de acido y 8d6+20 de daño de fuego} (@Check[reflex|dc:31|basic] salvacion).

Boiling Tub Trap.publicNotes: Un cable trampa roto hace detonar una bomba alquimica y revienta parte de la tina de hojalata, derramando liquido hirviente por la zona.

La furia dura 1 minuto, hasta que no queden enemigos que Bolar pueda percibir, o hasta que Bolar caiga inconsciente.

Cuando termina la furia, Bolar no puede volver a entrar en Furia durante 1 minuto.

Burning Chandelier Trap.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:36|name:Disable a Chandelier|traits:action:disable-a-device] (maestro) to disable a chandelier or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (8th rank; counteract DC 33) to permanently drain the magic from a chandelier. Burning Chandelier Trap.reset: La trampa deactivates y resets 1 minuto after there are no criatura vivas remaining in the room.
Burning Chandelier Trap.routine: (4 actions) For every chandelier disabled, the trap's actions are reduced by 1. For each of the trap's actions, a different chandelier attacks a random criatura in the room. A chandelier uses its swinging chandelier attack if it can, but it can't make melee attacks against criaturas in the cage, the closet, or the gap between the two double doors leading into the vault. Against a criatura it can't reach with a melee attack, it uses a flame dart attack instead. La trampa doesn't take multiple attack penalties.

The chandeliers drop several pies on elongated chains, allowing them to swing around the room. The closest chandelier to the triggering criatura makes a swinging chandelier Golpe against it. La trampa then rolls initiative.

weapon->+2 Greater Striking axiomatic Sc.description: A scourge-also known as a cat-o'-nine-tails-is a set of several knotted cords made from cotton or leather y attached to a handle. While most scourges are more suitable for torture than combat, the armas used by the Order of the Scourge have metal barbs woven in to pierce clothing y armor. The scourge is a martial melee arma.

action->Suicidal Obedience.name: Suicidal Obedience
action->Suicidal Obedience.description:
Carvey is unerringly loyal to the Skinsaw cult y to Mobana especially. When Carvey goes berserk, she doesn't attack the nearest criatura viva or object but instead moves adjacent to the criatura nearest the balcony (or similar falling hazard, if the battle is taking place elsewhere) y attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} the criatura over the cliff's edge.

The number of pies Carvey can Shove a criatura is doubled as long as Carvey has 40 or fewer HP (thus, she pushes a criatura 10 pies on a sucessful check y 20 pies on a critical success), but she must move the same distance y in the same direction as the pushed criatura.

If the shoved criatura falls over the cliff's edge, so does Carvey.

action->Berserk.name: Berserk
action->Berserk.description:
A severely damaged flesh golem has a chance of going berserk.

If it has 40 or fewer HP at the start of its turn, the golem debe tener exito en una @Check[flat|dc:5] check or go berserk. A berserk golem wildly attacks the nearest criatura viva, or the nearest object if no criaturas are nearby.

action->Electric Reflexes.name: Electric Reflexes
action->Electric Reflexes.description:
Desencadenante El golem sufre daño de electricidad y a criatura is adjacent to it.

Efecto El golem lashes out y tries to GRAB a nearby criatura. The golem attempts an ATHLETICS check to [[/act grapple]] an adjacent criatura. The criatura also takes @Damage[3d6[electricity]] daño on a success, or @Damage[6d6[electricity]] daño on a critical success.

action->Golem Antimagic.name: Golem Antimagic
action->Golem Antimagic.description:
harmed by fire ([[/r 5d8]], [[/r 3d4]] from areas or daño persistente); healed by electricity (area [[/r 2d4[healing]]] Puntos de Golpe); ralentizado by cold

A golem is immune to conjuros y magical abilities other than its own, but each type of golem is affected by a few types of magic in special ways. If an entry lists multiple types (such as "cold y water"), either type of conjuro can affect the golem.

Harmed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem causes it to take the listed amount of daño (this daño has no type) instead of the usual effect. If the golem starts its turn in an area of magic of this type or is affected by a persistent effect of the appropriate type, it takes the daño listed in the parenthetical.

Healed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem makes the golem lose the ralentizado condicion y gain HP equal to half the daño the conjuro would have dealt. If the golem starts its turn in an area of this type of magic, it gains the HP listed in the parenthetical.

Slowed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem causes it to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} for [[/br 2d6 #rounds]]{2d6 rounds} instead of the usual effect. If the golem starts its turn in an area of this type of magic, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} for that round.

Vulnerable To Each golem is vulnerable to one or more specific conjuros, with the effects described in its stat block.

action->Vulnerable to Flesh to Stone.name: Vulnerable to Flesh to Stone
action->Vulnerable to Flesh to Stone.description: Casting a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.znv4ECL7ZtuiagtA]{Petrify} conjuro on the flesh golem affects the golem normally.

action->Berserk Slam.name: Berserk Slam
action->Berserk Slam.description:
Requisito The flesh golem is berserk.

Efecto El flesh golem Golpes with its fist at a -1 penalizador por circunstancia. If it hits, it inflige 1d6 daño adicional y knocks el objetivo @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}.

weapon->+1 Striking Sap.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.TLQErnOpM9Luy7rL]
+1 Striking Sap

armor->Chain Shirt.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.MPcM4Wt6KmWE2kGL]

Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail y protects only the torso, upper arms, y upper legs of its wearer.

action->Escort from the Premises.name: Escort from the Premises
action->Escort from the Premises.description:
Requisitos El casino bouncer has Grabbed a Medium or smaller target y is wielding a nonlethal arma in the other hand

Efecto El casino bouncer makes a Golpe against the grabbed target with the nonlethal arma. If the Golpe hits, it inflige daño as usual y the casino bouncer moves el objetivo 5 pies (this is forced movement) y Steps into the space el objetivo had just occupied.

action->Intimidating Stare.name: Intimidating Stare
action->Intimidating Stare.description:
The casino bouncer attempts to [[/act demoralize]] a criatura with a mere glance. The casino bouncer doesn't take a penalizador to their INTIMIDATION check if el objetivo doesn't speak the same language.

If the bouncer rolls a critical success, el objetivo can't reduce the value of its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado} condicion until [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 asaltos} have passed.

Chalky.name: Chalky
Chalky.publicNotes: Este gólem es una pesadilla alquímica ambulante capaz de infligir toda clase de heridas dolorosas. Su capacidad para obedecer órdenes procede del cerebro humanoide, por lo demás carente de mente, que flota en su cabeza en forma de cúpula. En casos excepcionalmente raros, un residuo de personalidad o memoria se adhiere a ese cerebro y se manifiesta como hábitos extraños.

action->Alchemical Chambers.name: Alchemical Chambers
action->Alchemical Chambers.description:
An alchemical golem's body contains six alchemical chambers filled with different substances. When an alchemical golem ability calls upon a randomly determined alchemical effect, roll 1d6 y consult the following :

[[/gmr 1d6 #Alchemical Efecto]] Alchemical Efecto
1

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.TZUskLT7yvP7N2co]{Elixir of Life (Lesser)}
2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.T4ouD4mVFHA3EHs6]{Bomber's Eye Elixir (Lesser)}
3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.oCuwJ9IUDAuzsUwa]{Bravo's Brew (Moderate)}
4 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bQPRKEpnLakJBAAh]{Cat's Eye Elixir}
5 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.AqLxu3ir4UGzdOaz]{Cheetah's Elixir (Moderate)}
6 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.TMtQnY6yvIRCpK9v]{Juggernaut Mutagen (Greater)}

action->Alchemical Rupture.name: Alchemical Rupture
action->Alchemical Rupture.description:
When an alchemical golem sufre daño físico from a impacto critico or is affected by a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1xbFBQDRs0hT5xZ9]{Shatter} conjuro, one glass chamber within its body shatters, spewing alchemical liquid in a @Template[emanation|distance:5].

Roll on the alchemical chambers list to determine which one shatters - all criaturas within a @Template[emanation|distance:5] are affected by the elixir in the randomly rolled alchemical chamber, y these criaturas may forego their Reflex saves against the effect if they wish.

action->Golem Antimagic.name: Golem Antimagic
action->Golem Antimagic.description:
harmed by sonic ([[/r 5d8]], [[/r 2d6]] from areas or daño persistente); healed by acid (area [[/r 2d4[healing]]] Puntos de Golpe); ralentizado by cold

A golem is immune to conjuros y magical abilities other than its own, but each type of golem is affected by a few types of magic in special ways. If an entry lists multiple types (such as "cold y water"), either type of conjuro can affect the golem.

If the golem starts its turn in an area of this type of magic, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} for that round.

Vulnerable To Each golem is vulnerable to one or more specific conjuros, with the effects described in its stat block.

action->Vulnerable to Shatter.name: Vulnerable to Shatter
action->Vulnerable to Shatter.description: Casting a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1xbFBQDRs0hT5xZ9]{Shatter} conjuro on an alchemical golem affects the golem normally, but also causes an alchemical rupture.

action->Alchemical Injection.name: Alchemical Injection
action->Alchemical Injection.description:
When an alchemical golem hits a criatura with a syringe Golpe, roll 1d6 on the alchemical chambers list to determine the additional effect of the attack.

Chalky's alchemical chambers are filled with helpful potions y elixirs rather than harmful substances. When Chalky targets an ally with its syringe Golpe, the ally takes no daño y doesn't need to make a save against the rolled effect.

action->Adamantine Strikes.name: Adamantine Golpes
action->Adamantine Strikes.description: Chaos Gulgamodh's body—including the appendages it uses to make melee Golpes—is made of adamantine.

action->Cannon Fusillade.name: Cannon Fusillade
action->Cannon Fusillade.description:
Chaos Gulgamodh unleashes a salvo of explosive blasts in a @Template[cone|distance:30]. Las criaturas in the area take @Damage[(10d10+20)[fire]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:43|basic] salvacion).

On a failed save, a criatura is subjected to a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.rollable-tables.RollTable.yRZwPolTnRdnz42V]{Warpwave} effect. On a critically failed save, a criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 1}.

Chaos Gulgamodh can't use Cannon Fusillade again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Cannon Fusillade]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Trample.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.UNah0bxXxkcZjxO3]

Huge or smaller, pies, @Check[reflex|dc:43|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Trample]

action->Split.name: Split
action->Split.description: When a child of venom is hit by an attack that would deal cortante or daño perforante y the child of venom has at least 20 HP, the criatura splits into two identical children of venom with half the original's HP. One child of venom is in the same space as the original, y the other appears in an adjacent unoccupied space. If no adjacent space is unoccupied, they automatically push criaturas y objects out of the way to fill a space.

action->Sneak Attack.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.AWvNPE4U0kEJSL1T]

The child of venom inflige an additional 3d6 daño de precision to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} criaturas.

action->Suction.name: Suction
action->Suction.description: The child of venom can CLIMB on ceilings y other inverted surfaces, though such surfaces are difficult terrain for them.

action->Efficient Winding.name: Efficient Winding
action->Efficient Winding.description:
For the clockwork amalgam to act, it must be wound with a unique key by another criatura. Este takes 1 minuto. Once wound, it remains operational for 7 days, after which time it becomes unaware of its surroundings y can't act until it's wound again.

The amalgam can enter standby mode as a 3-action activity. Its operational time doesn't decrease in standby, but it can sense its surroundings (with a -2 penalizador to Perception). It can't act, with one exception: when it perceives a criatura, it can exit standby as a reaction (rolling initiative if appropriate).

A criatura can intentar una [[/act disable-device dc=33]]{DC 33 THIEVERY} check to Disable a Device to wind the amalgam down. For each success, the assassin loses 1 hora of operational time. Este can be done even if the amalgam is in standby mode.

action->Recalibrate.name: Recalibrate
action->Recalibrate.description: El clockwork amalgam puede recalibrate su internal structure a shed damaged components y replace them con nuevo ones, restoring @Damage[125[healing]] PG a el construct. Each time ello usa este ability, el clockwork amalgam permanently deactivates one de su five melee ataques as el components de que arm reassemble dentro de el core de el machine.

action->Whirring Doom.name: Whirring Doom
action->Whirring Doom.description:
Frecuencia una vez por asalto

The clockwork amalgam becomes a blur of spinning weaponry. It makes up to five melee Golpes (one for each active melee attack it has available), taking a -4 penalizador to the tirada de ataque for each attack, but ignoring the multiple attack penalizador until it has made all of its attacks. It can use each melee attack only once y it can target each criatura in reach only once. If the clockwork amalgam used Whirring Doom in the previous round, it can use it again this round using only 1 action instead of 3. The amalgam's movement Velocidad is halved until el final de su siguiente turno.

Clockwork Arms.name: Clockwork Arms
Clockwork Arms.description: Four claw-tipped clockwork arms suspended from the ceiling pick up y deposit criaturas into a nearby hatch.
Clockwork Arms.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:43|name:Deactivate One Arm|traits:action:disable-a-device] (maestro) to jam y deactivate one of the arms or @Check[athletics|dc:46|name:Tear Arm Off Machine] (legendario) to tear an arm off the machine.
Clockwork Arms.routine: (4 actions) La trampa loses 1 action per arm destroyed or disabled. On its turn, the trap makes claw Golpes against criaturas other than the Rumormonger or the Inkmaster. If an arm already has a criatura grabbed, the trap spends 2 actions to use its Open Hatch ability.

action->Arm Activation.name: Arm Activation
action->Arm Activation.description:
Desencadenante El Rumormonger or the Inkmaster enters the room

Efecto La trampa rolls initiative.

action->Open Hatch.name: Open Hatch
action->Open Hatch.description: The metal hatch opens y the arms deposit a grabbed Medium or smaller criatura into the hole. The criatura becomes caught in the gears (see Caught in Gears) durante 1 asalto before emerging in area K5. Reset Rewinding the gears for [[/gmr 1d4 #minutes]]{1d4 minutes} resets the trap.

action->Attack of Opportunity.name: Ataque de oportunidad
action->Attack of Opportunity.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura al alcance del monstruo usa una accion de manipular o una accion de movimiento, realiza un ataque a distancia o abandona una casilla durante una accion de movimiento que esta usando.

Efecto El monstruo intenta un Golpe cuerpo a cuerpo contra la criatura desencadenante. Si el ataque es un impacto critico y el desencadenante fue una accion de manipular, el monstruo interrumpe esa accion. Este Golpe no cuenta para el penalizador por ataques multiples del monstruo, y su penalizador por ataques multiples no se aplica a este Golpe.

action->Integrated Launcher.name: Integrated Launcher
action->Integrated Launcher.description: Un lanzaproyectiles esta integrado en los sistemas de un asesino mecanico, con 10 hojas giratorias y cinco bombas de humo. Cuando el asesino es destruido, el lanzador y su municion tambien son destruidos.

action->Smoke Vision.name: Vision entre humo
action->Smoke Vision.description: El humo no perjudica la vision de un agradaemon; ignora la condicion oculto causada por el humo.

action->Wind-Up.description: For the clockwork assassin to act, it must be wound with a unique key by another criatura. Este takes 1 minuto. For each success, the assassin loses 1 hora of operational time. Este can be done even if the assassin is in standby mode.

action->Rapid Repair.name: Rapid Repair
action->Rapid Repair.description: The clockwork assassin spends 1 hora of its operational time to REPAIR itself, regaining 25 Puntos de Golpe y refilling its integrated projectile launcher with 4 spinning blades (to a maximum of 10) y 2 smoke bombs (to a maximum of 5).

action->Smoke Bomb Launcher.name: Smoke Bomb Launcher
action->Smoke Bomb Launcher.description: The clockwork assassin launches a smoke bomb. A screen of thick, opaque smoke fills a @Template[burst|distance:10] within 60 pies of the clockwork assassin. Las criaturas within the area are concealed, y all other criaturas are concealed to them. The smoke lasts durante 1 minuto or until dispersed by a strong wind.

action->Sneak Attack.name: Ataque furtivo
action->Sneak Attack.description: The clockwork assassin's Golpes deal an additional 3d6 daño de precision to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} criaturas.

action->Unbalancing Blow.name: Golpe desequilibrante
action->Unbalancing Blow.description: Las criaturas hit by the clockwork assassin's rapier mano Golpe are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} hasta el comienzo de the clockwork assassin's next turn.

action->Whirlwind Strike.description: The chopper makes a melee Golpe against each enemigo within melee reach. Its multiple attack penalizador doesn't increase until after all the attacks.

Clockwork Poison Bomb.name: Clockwork Poison Bomb
Clockwork Poison Bomb.description: Un clockwork bomb releases gouts de poisonous humo. El humo issues forth de un single nozzle attached a two tanks de pressurized veneno
Clockwork Poison Bomb.disable: Three [[/act disable-device dc=31]]{DC 31 THIEVERY} (experto) checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable a Device} to disable the latches that lock the nozzle in place, then one [[/act disable-device dc=35]]{DC 35 THIEVERY} (maestro) check to Disable a Device to turn off the nozzle; DCs decrease by 2 if Oggvurm is immobilized, paralyzed, unconscious, or dead
Clockwork Poison Bomb.hpDetails: to ruin the nozzle (making it impossible to disable, in which case the only way to disarm the bomb is to destroy both its tanks); Tank Hardness 15; Tank HP 80 (UR 40) to destroy one of the tanks (both tanks must be destroyed to disarm the bomb
Clockwork Poison Bomb.reset: La trampa issues smoke for 3 minutes before its tanks run dry. The tanks must be replaced before the bomb can be reactivated.
Clockwork Poison Bomb.routine: (1 action) On its turn, the bomb spews forth a smoky gout of airborne @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.WvDbdESFJY6Be2u1]{Blackfinger Blight} poison. The cloud fills a 20-pies radius, or a 10-pies radius if only one tank remains intact. If the bomb is already in the center of a blackfinger blight cloud, the radius of that cloud increases by 20 pies (or 10 pies, if only one tank remains intact) instead.
Clockwork Poison Bomb.stealth: El bomb usa Oggvurm's initiative roll as su Stealth roll

action->Poisonous Cloud.name: Poisonous Cloud
action->Poisonous Cloud.description:
Desencadenante El bomb is Activated, which requires 3 actions

Dart Barrage.name: Dart Barrage
Dart Barrage.description: Four dart-loaded pipes oculto en el diagonal muros son connected a un pressure plate under el brass seal en el sala's center.
Dart Barrage.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:22|name:Disable Pressure Plate|traits:action:disable-a-device] (entrenado) to disable the pressure plate, or four @Check[thievery|dc:18|name:Plug Dart Launcher|traits:action:disable-a-device] (entrenado) checks to plug the dart launchers
Dart Barrage.hpDetails: (UR 30) to destroy the seal y disable the trap
Dart Barrage.reset: La trampa runs out of darts after 4 asaltos of firing y must be reset manually by dismantling the walls to reload the launchers. If at any point there are no longer more than two criaturas placing weight on the floor, the trap ceases firing but remains armed, ready to resume firing its remaining darts once triggered again.
Dart Barrage.routine: (4 actions) La trampa loses 1 action for each disabled launcher. On each of the trap's actions, it fires one dart at a criatura in the center of the room.
Dart Barrage.stealth: (entrenado) or @Check[perception|dc:23|traits:action:seek] (entrenado) to notice scratches around the musical pipes y a slight give to the seal

action->Vein Walker.description: El excorion mueve about by way de hundreds de pulsating sangre vessels, que stretch de su cuerpo en dozens de tight, ropy bundles y anchor ello a el suelo. Un excorion cannot be Tripped, Shoved, o otherwise forcibly moved except by magia, y el excorion ignora el terreno dificil (but no terreno dificil mayor).

action->Spawn Mirror Duplicate.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura moves between the two glass faces of Olansa Terimor

Efecto El planar rift disgorges an evil mirror duplicate of the criatura, y the duplicate rolls initiative.

The field of opposition can use this reaction una vez por asalto but can't spawn a duplicate of a criatura that already has a mirror duplicate in existence.

action->Mirror Duplicate.name: Mirror Duplicate
action->Mirror Duplicate.description:
A mirror duplicate rolls initiative with a +45 modifier. It uses the same statistics as the original criatura, but with a +2 bonificador de estado to AC, attacks, y tiradas de salvacion. The duplicate is evil, y any abilities reliant on alignment change accordingly. The duplicate is also aggressive, attacking y taking other hostile actions available to it against anyone other than mirror duplicates.

It has three actions y one reaction y can use any of the original criatura's abilities. Any limited-use abilities (such as conjuro slots) are based on what the original had when duplicated y are used up separately from the original criatura's. The duplicate also has duplicates of the criatura's worn y held items, but not consumables.

A duplicate is destroyed when reduced to 0 HP, when the trap is disabled or destroyed, or when the duplicate leaves area E2. Its duplicated items disappear when they leave its grip, though they last long enough for ranged Golpes.

Flying Guillotine.name: Flying Guillotine
Flying Guillotine.description: An invisible magical glyph on the guillotine's blade detects criatura vivas in the room, which causes the guillotine to volar off its hinges y attack.
Flying Guillotine.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:20|name:Erase Glyph|traits:action:disable-a-device] (entrenado) to erase the glyph (which requires a successful unarmed tirada de ataque if the blade is already active) or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (3rd rank; counteract DC 20) to counteract it. La trampa has a secret bypass known only to Ralso y Pratchett: as long as the guillotine can see a criatura in the room touching thumb y pinky together with an empty hand, it remains dormant.
Flying Guillotine.reset: After 1 minuto, the trap deactivates, though the door remains locked. La trampa rearms itself each day at dawn.
Flying Guillotine.routine: (1 action) The blade @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cS9nfDRGD83bNU1p]{Flies} up to 20 pies y Golpes any criaturas whose squares it passes through. It cannot target the same criatura more than una vez por asalto. The blade cannot be grappled y doesn't take a multiple attack penalizador.

action->Bloody Rebel.name: Bloody Rebel
action->Bloody Rebel.description:
Franca quickly slashes at nearby foes, aiming to maim rather than disable. She makes up to three melee Golpes, each against a different criatura within reach.

Estos Golpes count toward Franca's multiple attack penalizador, but the penalizador doesn't increase until after all three Golpes are made.

Con un impacto, the Golpe inflige @Damage[3[bleed]] daño instead of its normal daño.

Con un impacto critico, the criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} until the beginning of Franca's next turn or until they spend an action to remove the condicion, whichever comes first.

action->Hamstring.name: Hamstring

Efecto Franca inflige @Damage[6[bleed]] daño to el objetivo criatura, y el objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1}.

Franca uncorks y flings a dose of poison at a bleeding foe.

She retrieves a poison from her inventory, then splashes it at a criatura within 10 pies that is currently taking @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistente Bleed Dano}.

The criatura debe tener exito en una @Check[reflex|dc:32] salvacion or be exposed to the poison.

action->Freeze Floor.name: Freeze Floor
action->Freeze Floor.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura enters one of the three squares marked with a T on the map

Efecto El floor of the entire 10-pies-by-15-pies antechamber freezes over, sending deadly magical frost creeping up the legs of the intruders. Any criaturas standing in the room must roll a @Check[reflex|dc:45] salvacion.

Éxito critico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura takes @Damage[(3d10+5)[cold]] daño.

Fallo The criatura takes @Damage[(6d10+10)[cold]] daño y is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} for [[/br 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 asaltos}.

Fallo critico The criatura takes @Damage[(12d10+20)[cold]] daño y is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} durante 1 minuto.

Additionally, the golems in area B10 become aware of the intruders. The golems activate y come to this room to attack, if they haven't been destroyed already.

action->Rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenecimiento
action->Rejuvenation.description:
Cuando Frefferth es destruido, su cuerpo y objetos dissipate into shadowy nothingness y el knight re-forms after [[/gmr 1d4 #days]]{1d4 days} dentro de el sarcophagus en area D12, fully healed.

Frefferth puede be trapped solo by returning el @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.6MIBHKMJmD8uQVam]{Chain de el Stilled espiritual} a el sarcophagus (see areas D12 y D34), en que case Frefferth's cuerpo dissipates, leaving su objetos en el spot where el fue last slain.

action->Head Hunter.name: Head Hunter
action->Head Hunter.description:
Any cortante arma a dullahan wields becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.hg3IogR8ue2IWwgS]{Keen}, y any hatchet it wields becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.qlunQzfnzPQpMG6U]{Returning}.

If the dullahan kills a criatura with a impacto critico using a cortante arma, el objetivo is decapitated as though the dullahan had used Reap on el objetivo.

Estos effects remain only while the dullahan holds the arma.

action->Impaler.name: Impaler
action->Impaler.description:
Siempre que Frefferth damages a criatura with a impacto critico using a ranged perforante arma, the arma remains impaled in the victim's body.

The victim becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 1} as long as they are impaled; the impaling arma can be removed by the affected criatura or an adjacent ally as a 2-action activity that has the manipulate rasgo.

action->Reap.name: Reap
action->Reap.description:
Frefferth removes the head of a dead criatura within reach.

Each criatura within the area of Frefferth's frightful presence debe intentar una new save, even if they are temporarily immune.

action->Summon Steed.name: Summon Steed
action->Summon Steed.description:
Frefferth summons a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.qRUqoezeEnQ2KdyT]{Nightmare}.

Este steed remains until it is slain, Frefferth @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AjLSHZSWQ90exdLo]{Dismisses} it, or Frefferth summons another steed.

action->Charming Liar.description:
When Gage gets a critical success using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} action, la esencia del objetivo attitude toward him improves by one step, as though he'd succeeded at using DIPLOMACY to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}.

Este works only once per conversation, y if he critically succeeds against multiple targets using the same result, he chooses one criatura's attitude to improve.

To use this ability, Gage must be lying to impart seemingly important information, inflate his status, or ingratiate himself, which trivial or irrelevant lies can't achieve.

action->Smooth Operator.name: Smooth Operator
action->Smooth Operator.description:
When Gage meets a group of up to five people, he can immediately intentar una DIPLOMACY check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}, comparing the result to the Will DC of each target.

He sufre un -3 penalizador on this check, y it is possible to get different degrees of success for each target. If he fails or critically fails, he can engage in 1 minuto of conversation y intentar una new check at the end of that time rather than accepting the failure or critical failure result.

action->Sidestep.description:

action->Point Blank.description: The maestro assassin makes a crossbow Golpe against an adjacent enemigo; unlike most ranged Golpes, this Golpe doesn't provoke reactions. If successful, the attack inflige an additional 4d8 daño de precision.

action->Study Target.description: The maestro assassin observes a single target she can see, allowing her to use her Vorpal Garrote during the next round.

action->Vorpal Garrote.name: Vorpal Garrote
action->Vorpal Garrote.description:
Requisitos El maestro assassin used Study Target during the previous round y must have a garrote bolt

Efecto El maestro assassin makes a crossbow Golpe against el objetivo she previously studied. If she rolls a success on her tirada de ataque, she gets a critical success instead. El objetivo debe intentar una @Check[fortitude|dc:36|traits:damaging-effect] salvacion.

Éxito No additional effect.

Fallo El objetivo sufre an additional 3d12 daño de precision.

Fallo critico El objetivo is decapitated y instantly dies unless it doesn't require a head to live.

Gas Trap.name: Gas Trap
Gas Trap.description: Un spring slams y locks el sala's puerta before four oculto gas vents begin pumping veneno gas into el camara.
Gas Trap.disable: Four @Check[thievery|dc:20|name:Block Gas Vents|traits:action:disable-a-device] pruebas a block el gas vents, o un @Check[thievery|dc:26|name:Unlock Door|traits:action:pick-a-lock] prueba a unlock el puerta y escapar
Gas Trap.reset: La trampa must be manually rearmed by unblocking the vents or replacing the poison gas tank in area E30.
Gas Trap.routine:
(1 action) Each round on its initiative count, the trap pumps more toxic gas into the room.

Any breathing criatura in the room takes @Damage[4d6[poison]] daño (a successful @Check[fortitude|dc:22|traits:poison,damaging-effect] salvacion halves the daño taken). If a criatura acts before the trap on the first round, it has the option of holding its breath to postpone taking daño from the trap-holding one's breath after the trap's first action has no effect, since the air in the criatura's lungs is already tainted. Locating y blocking one of the hidden gas vents reduces the daño de veneno by 1d6-if all four are blocked, the trap is disabled, though the door remains locked. Otherwise, the trap functions durante 1 minuto before all the gas is expended y characters in the room cease taking daño, after which the trap ventilates the room for 1 additional minute.
Gas Trap.stealth: (entrenado) to smell the poison gas or hear it hissing

action->Free Blade.name: Free Blade
action->Free Blade.description:
Desencadenante El ghaele ends its turn while unable to act or attempts a greatsword Golpe that would take a circumstance or penalizador de estado.

Efecto A ghaele's blade is implacable in the pursuit of freedom, y its energies can overpower any effect that would interfere with its swordplay.

The ghaele attempts to counteract each effect that prevents it from making a greatsword Golpe, gives it a penalizador to its greatsword Golpe, or prevents it from acting.

The ghaele can use this ability even if it's otherwise unable to act.

action->Light Form.name: Light Form
action->Light Form.description:
A ghaele's body is partially corporeal y partially composed of light, with a color corresponding to the elemental energy currently residing in its blade (see Elige Weakness).

It can move through solid objects but can't end its action within a solid object.

action->Choose Weakness.name: Elige Weakness
action->Choose Weakness.description:
A ghaele attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about a foe they are facing.

If successful, they can change the elemental daño dealt by their greatsword y light ray to acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic, usually to match the foe's weakness.

They can also change their energy resistance to any of these energy types (this can be a different type than for their attacks).

The choices remain until they next use Elige Weakness.

action->Ghaele's Gaze.name: Ghaele's Gaze
action->Ghaele's Gaze.description:
When a ghaele fixes their gaze upon a non-good criatura, the criatura is subjected to the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sX2o0HH4RjJDAZ8C]{Divine Decree} (@Check[will|dc:20|name:Divine Decree|traits:damaging-effect] salvacion).

Grunka.name: Grunka
Grunka.publicNotes:
Los combatientes de primera linea de las tribus goblin prefieren luchar en grandes grupos, sobre todo cuando pueden superar a sus enemigos al menos en proporcion de tres a uno.

Estos humanoides pequenos tienen la piel verde o gris y cabezas grandes con orejas anchas. Aunque algunos goblins son civilizados y se han esforzado mucho por ser considerados miembros respetables de comunidades humanoides, la mayoria son criaturas impetuosas y crueles que disfrutan causando estragos. A estos goblins no les importa sacrificar ganado, robar bebes o incendiar un edificio solo por una diversion momentanea. Se deleitan gastando bromas maliciosas a humanoides mas altos, a quienes llaman "piernilargos".

Los goblins son supersticiosos, sienten un profundo temor reverencial por la magia y fascinacion por el fuego; los goblins que dominan la magia o el fuego se ganan un gran respeto entre los suyos. A la mayoria de los demas humanoides les cuesta entender la mentalidad goblin: odian a los caninos pero comparten con entusiasmo sus guaridas con los llamados "perros goblin", atacan sin miedo a criaturas mas grandes pero les aterrorizan los caballos, y desprecian las verduras aunque consideran los encurtidos un manjar. Para un goblin, por supuesto, todas estas son decisiones vitales perfectamente sensatas.

action->Activate Attractor.name: Activar Attractor
action->Activate Attractor.description:
The hundun releases its staff-like attractor, which hovers in place. The hundun can use an action, which has the concentrate rasgo, to move the attractor up to 60 pies, to a maximum of 300 pies from the hundun. It can also use an action, which has the concentrate rasgo, to recall the attractor, which flies to the hundun y immediately deactivates.

Las criaturas within 40 pies of the attractor debe intentar una @Check[will|dc:40|name:Attractor] salvacion if they're within the area when the attractor is activated or as soon as they enter the area while it's active. Once a criatura has attempted the save, it uses the same result for the rest of that activation of the attractor.

Any restrictions on a criatura's movement apply only if it voluntarily moves away from the attractor. For example, if the attractor moves closer to a criatura, the criatura doesn't then need to move away.

Chaotic criaturas are immune to the effects of the attractor.

The attractor can't be harmed by physical attacks but is destroyed by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{Disintegrate}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ihbRf964JDXztcy3]{Disjunction}, a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.HuGZspUvJqR09Y8u]{Rod of Cancellation}, a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.B4DnQNcGl6nFVKHl]{Sphere of Annihilation}, y other similarly powerful effects.

The attractor has an AC of 40 y a counteract DC of 37. A hundun can rebuild a destroyed attractor after [[/gmr 1d8 #hours]]{1d8 hours} of uninterrupted meditation. If the hundun is slain, its attractor disappears.

Éxito critico The criatura's movement isn't restricted.

Éxito The criatura treats each square in the area as difficult terrain when moving away from the attractor.

Fallo The criatura can't move away from the attractor within the area.

action->Entropy Sense (Imprecise) 60 fee.name: Entropy Sense (Imprecise) 60 pies
action->Entropy Sense (Imprecise) 60 fee.description:
Il'setya can anticipate the most likely location of a criatura through their supernatural insight into the forces of chaotic probabilities y chance. Este grants Il'setya the ability to sense criaturas within the listed range.

The Il'setya's entropy sense doesn't detect criaturas under the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EoKBlgf6Smt8opaU]{Veil of Privacy} or that are otherwise shielded from divinations y predictions.

action->Fast Healing 5.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.fJSNOw4zHGbIm4bZ]
Fast Healing 5

action->Protean Anatomy 10.name: Protean Anatomy 10
action->Protean Anatomy 10.description:
Il'setya's vital organs shift y change shape y position constantly. Immediately after Il'setya sufre daño de acido, electricidad o sonico, she gains the listed amount of resistance to that tipo de daño. Este lasts durante 1 hora or until the next time she sufre daño of one of the other types (in which case its resistance changes to match that type), whichever comes first.

Il'setya is immune to polymorph effects unless she is a willing target. If @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Ensordecido}, Il'setya automatically recovers at el final de su siguiente turno as new sensory organs grow to replace the compromised ones.

action->Dimensional Slide.name: Dimensional Slide
action->Dimensional Slide.description:
Frecuencia twice per day

Efecto Il'setsya steps through a transient hole in space, instantly teleporting to a space within 60 pies that she can see.

action->Prehensile Tail.name: Cola prensil
action->Prehensile Tail.description: Il'setsya's prehensile tail can hold y manipulate objects of Light Bulk or less, though it cannot be used to attack. She can spend an Interactuar action to use her tail to fetch objects stowed on her person, such as potions.

action->Warpwave Spell.name: Warpwave Spell
action->Warpwave Spell.description:
Il'setsya infuses her next conjuro with roiling currents of chaos.

If Il'setsya Casts a Spell before her turn is over y the conjuro affects a criatura, that criatura is also subject to a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.rollable-tables.RollTable.yRZwPolTnRdnz42V]{Warpwave}.

If she doesn't Lanzar un conjuro before the beginning of her next turn, this action is wasted.

Ink Drowning Vats.name: Ink Drowning Vats
Ink Drowning Vats.description: Steel hatch doors automatically lock shut in each of the four vats labeled J2. Four ink spouts (one per vat) jut through a narrow aperture in the ceiling of each vat, 20 pies above.
Ink Drowning Vats.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:40|name:Seal an Ink Spout|traits:action:disable-a-device] (maestro) to seal an ink spout, @Check[thievery|dc:48|name:Unlock a Door|traits:action:pick-a-lock] (maestro) to unlock a steel hatch door, or @Check[athletics|dc:45|name:Force Open a Door|traits:action:force-open] (maestro) to FORCE OPEN a steel hatch door
Ink Drowning Vats.reset: La trampa can be reset by refilling the ink storage tanks above the vats.
Ink Drowning Vats.routine: (4 actions) La trampa loses 1 action for each disabled ink spout. On each of the trap's actions, a spout pours ink, increasing the depth of the ink in that vat by 2 pies. Las criaturas standing in the ink are exposed to a dose of poison ink. Once the vat is full of ink, the trap stops using actions, but criaturas in the vat might start drowning.

action->Fill Tank.name: Fill Tank
action->Fill Tank.description:
Desencadenante El switch outside the vats is pulled

Efecto La trampa rolls initiative.

action->Poison Ink.name: Poison Ink
action->Poison Ink.description:
Tirada de salvacion @Check[fortitude|dc:38]

Duración máxima 10 asaltos

Etapa 1 3d6 daño de veneno y sickened 1 (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 4d6 daño de veneno y sickened 2 (1 asalto)

Inky Tendrils.name: Inky Tendrils
Inky Tendrils.description: Six giant tentacles reach up de el ink lake, grabbing cualquier foes en reach y dragging them underwater.
Inky Tendrils.disable:
@Check[athletics|dc:48|name:Disable Athletics] (legendario) or @Check[acrobatics|dc:45|name:Disable Acrobatics] (maestro) to tie one tentacle into a knot, rendering it useless, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (8th rank; counteract DC 44) to counteract one tentacle.

The death of the Daemonic Rumormonger permanently dispels all the inky tendrils.
Inky Tendrils.routine: (6 actions) The hazard loses 1 action for every tentacle that is disabled or destroyed. The tentacles can combine their actions to use the hazard's Inky Imitator ability. A broken tentacle can still Golpe, but it can't GRAB. Este hazard takes no multiple attack penalizador.

action->Black Ink Delirium.name: Black Ink Delirium
action->Black Ink Delirium.description:
Tirada de salvacion @Check[fortitude|dc:38]

Duración máxima 4 asaltos

Etapa 1 @Damage[3d6[poison]] daño y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 2} (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 @Damage[6d6[poison]] daño y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confundido} (1 asalto)

action->Inky Imitator.name: Inky Imitator
action->Inky Imitator.description:
The inky tendrils cast a 10th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.73rToy0v5Ra9NvL6]{Duplicate Foe} conjuro (@Check[fortitude|dc:40|name:Duplicate Foe]) on el objetivo; on a failed save, a simulacrum of el objetivo made from dripping ink y clockwork scraps emerges from any other spot (tendrils' choice) in the lake.

The tendrils don't need to Sustain the Spell; the duplicate exists durante 1 minuto or until it is destroyed before collapsing into a puddle of ink y scrap metal.

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.g26YiEIfSHCpLocV]

@Damage[(2d8+10)[contundente]] plus black ink delirium, @Check[fortitude|dc:42|basic]

action->Tendrils Come Alive.description:
Desencadenante Una non-daemonic criatura moves a 15 pies o menos of the shoreline

Efecto El hazard makes a tentacle Golpe against the triggering criatura y the hazard rolls initiative.

Iron Maiden Trap.name: Iron Maiden Trap
Iron Maiden Trap.description: A pressure plate hidden on the floor before an iron maiden causes the torture device to snap shut y trap the triggering criatura inside.
Iron Maiden Trap.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:28|name:Disable Pressure Plate|traits:action:disable-a-device] a disable el pressure plate
Iron Maiden Trap.hpDetails: Iron Maiden Hardness 12; Iron Maiden HP 46 (UR 23)
Iron Maiden Trap.reset: El pressure plate debe be reinicia manually.

action->Slam Shut.name: Slam Shut
action->Slam Shut.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura steps onto the trap's pressure plate (indicated on the map)

Efecto El front of the iron maiden slams shut with incredible force y locks itself. The triggering criatura takes @Damage[(4d10+10)[perforante],2d6[bleed]]{4d10+10 daño perforante y 2d6 daño persistente de sangrado} (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic|options:inflicts:immobilized] salvacion; if the criatura critically succeeds, they avoid the trap completely). The triggering criatura is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}. The victim can end their immobilization only once a criatura outside the iron maiden unlocks the device (requiring two successful DC 28 THIEVERY checks to [[/act disable-device dc=28]]) or breaks the iron maiden, after which the trapped criatura debe tener exito en una DC 25 check to [[/act escape dc=25]] the trap's spike-lined interior.

action->Collapse.name: Desplome
action->Collapse.description:
Desencadenante El Iroran skeleton is critically hit

Efecto El Iroran skeleton collapses into a pile of bones y the attack inflige daño for a hit, rather than a impacto critico.

The skeleton can reform in a standing position as an action, but until it does, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizado} y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido}.

action->Flurry of Claws.name: Flurry of Claws
action->Flurry of Claws.description:
The Iroran skeleton makes two claw Golpes. If both hit the same criatura, the daño is combined for the purpose of resistances y weaknesses.

The multiple attack penalizador applies to the Golpes as normal.

action->Wall Run.name: Correr Por La Pared
action->Wall Run.description: The Iroran skeleton can Zancada along vertical surfaces, such as walls, as long as it begins y ends its movement on a horizontal surface.

action->Water Step.name: Water Dar un paso
action->Water Step.description: The Iroran skeleton can Zancada across liquid surfaces. If it ends its movement on a liquid surface, it falls in as normal.

action->Whirlwind Kick.name: Whirlwind Kick
action->Whirlwind Kick.description: The Iroran skeleton makes a single Golpe y compares the result to the AC of all criaturas within its reach, dealing daño to each criatura hit.
