equipment->Robe of Eyes.description:
Este garment appears to be an ordinary robe until donned, at which point numerous strange y alien eyes of varied shapes y colors open y blink across its fabric. While wearing the robe, obtienes a +3 bonificador por objeto to Perception checks, y tu constantly benefit from the effects of a 2nd-rank see @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} conjuro.

Puedes also see powerful magic auras. The highest-level magic aura a 30 pies o menos of tu glows in a color that reveals its school to tu y allows tu to determine where the effect originates. Este can narrow down the origin point of the effect to a 5-pies-cube, but not more precisely than that.

The robe of eyes is not without its dangers. If any conjuro with the light rasgo is cast on tu or tu square while estas wearing the robe, estas blinded for a number of rounds equal to the conjuro's rank unless tu succeed at a Fortitude save against the conjuro's DC.

Activar A Interactuar

Efecto Tu pluck an eye from the robe y toss it into the air, where it turns invisible y floats to a destination tu elige, with the same effect as a 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ek5XI0aEdZhBgm21]{Scouting Eye} conjuro. Puedes Sustain the Activation just as tu would be able to Sustain the Spell.

action->Lore Master.name: Lore Master
action->Lore Master.description: Ixusoth retains a vast amount of knowledge. She can use her Bardic LORE skill to Recall Knowledge on any topic, y she knows any languages common to an area she has spent a day or more in.

action->Eye Probe.name: Eye Probe
action->Eye Probe.description:
Frecuencia una vez al dia

Up to six of Ixusoth's eyes detach from her body. Each eye has AC 26, HP 1, y a volar speed of 40 pies. Ixusoth can see through all of her eye probes. She can move the probes all in separate directions using a single action. Ixusoth can have no more than six eye probes active at a time; using this ability to create more eyes causes the eye or eyes farthest away to shrivel y die.

Ixusoth can deliver touch conjuros through her eye probes y make melee conjuro attacks through them. In addition, she can Steal Memories through an eye probe using a single action by touching el objetivo with the eye.

action->Scatterbrain Palm.name: Scatterbrain Palm
action->Scatterbrain Palm.description:
A criatura hit by Ixusoth's fist Golpe debe intentar una @Check[will|dc:36|options:inflicts:aturdido] salvacion. The criatura is then temporarily immune hasta el comienzo de its next turn.

Éxito critico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Fallo The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.

Fallo critico The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3}, y the hyakume can use Steal Memories on el objetivo as part of this action.

action->Steal Memories.name: Steal Memories
action->Steal Memories.description: Ixusoth reaches out with her mind y attempts to steal memories from a criatura a 30 pies o menos. El objetivo debe tener exito en una @Check[will|dc:40] tirada de salvacion or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} y have some of its memories stolen. When Ixusoth steals memories, she learns some of the criatura's memories (chosen by the GM). Estos memories are then lost to that criatura.

Ixusoth.publicNotes: Esta prenda parece una tunica ordinaria hasta que se lleva puesta, momento en el que numerosos ojos extraños y alienígenas de formas y colores variados se abren y parpadean por toda la tela. Mientras llevas la tunica, obtienes un bonificador de objeto +3 a las pruebas de Percepción y puedes ver lo invisible y lo oculto con una claridad inquietante.

Algunos lanzadores de conjuros divinos, como los clérigos, pueden utilizar un símbolo religioso de su dios como foco divino para utilizar ciertas habilidades y lanzar algunos conjuros. Se debe sostener un símbolo religioso en una mano para usarlo.

action->Call Toxins.name: Call Toxins
action->Call Toxins.description: 30 pies. Flakfatter exudes an aura that makes poisons more potent. His melee Golpes deal an additional @Damage[2d8[persistent,poison]]. Las criaturas in the aura attempting a prueba plana to remove daño persistente de veneno must roll twice y take the lower result. Flakfatter can suppress or resume this aura as a free action.

action->Infector.name: Infector
action->Infector.description: Flakfatter targets a criatura a 30 pies o menos that's currently subject to a poison affliction. The poison affliction progresses to the next stage.

equipment->Disguise Kit (Elite).description: Este small wooden box contains cosmetics, false facial hair, spirit gum, y a few simple wigs. Tu usually need a disguise kit to set up a disguise in order to Impersonate someone using the DECEPTION skill. An elite disguise kit adds a +1 bonificador por objeto to relevant checks. If has crafted a large number of disguises, puedes replenish tu cosmetics supply with replacement cosmetics suitable for the type of tu disguise kit.

consumable->Healing Potion (Moderate).description: A healing potion is a vial of a ruby-red liquid that imparts a tingling sensation as the drinker's wounds heal rapidly. When tu drink a healing potion, tu regain @Damage[(3d8+10)[healing]] Puntos de Golpe.

Frecuencia una vez al dia

Desencadenante Kapral is targeted by an attack

consumable->Snake Oil.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.xBZCVHAa1SnR8Xul]

Activar A Interactuar

Puedes apply snake oil onto a wound or other outward symptom of an affliction or condicion (such as sores from a disease or discoloration from a poison). For the next hour, the symptom disappears y the wounded or afflicted criatura doesn't feel as if it still has the wound or affliction, though all effects remain. A criatura can uncover the ruse by succeeding at a @Check[perception|dc:17|traits:action:seek] check, but only if it uses a Seek action to specifically examine the snake oil's effects.

consumable->Tindertwig.name:

consumable->Tindertwig.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ylUdMTsfOQGJ3MN3]

Activar A Interactuar

An alchemical substance applied to one end of this tiny wooden stick ignites when struck against a rough surface. Creating a flame with a tindertwig is much faster than creating a flame with flint y steel. Puedes ignite the tindertwig y touch it to a flammable object as part of the same Interactuar action.

action->Cheek Pouches.name: Bolsas para las mejillas
action->Cheek Pouches.description: A ratfolk has stretchy cheek pouches that can store up to 1 cubic pies of objects. The ratfolk can remove or store an item using the Interactuar action. As long as the ratfolk has at least one object in its cheek pouches, its speech is noticeably difficult to understand.

action->Katar Specialist.name: Katar Specialist
action->Katar Specialist.description: Kekker has entrenado extensively with the katar blade. Any katar he wields gains the finesse rasgo.

action->Quick Stow.name: Quick Stow
action->Quick Stow.description:
Frecuencia una vez por asalto.

Efecto Kekker stores one held item of light or negligible Bulk in his cheek pouches.

action->Swarming.name: enjambre
action->Swarming.description:
A ratfolk can end its movement in the same square as an ally that also has this ability.

Only two such criaturas can share the same space.

effect->Spell Efecto: Mage Armor.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.qkwb5DD3zmKwvbk0]

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aAbfKn8maGjJjk2W]{Mystic Armor}

Tu ward yourself with shimmering magical energy, gaining a +1 bonificador por objeto to AC y a maximum Dexterity modifier of +5. While wearing mage armor, tu use tu unarmored proficiency to calculate tu AC.

action->Eschew Materials.name: Eschew Materials
action->Eschew Materials.description:
Puedes use clever workarounds to replicate the arcane essence of certain materials. When tu @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Lanzar un conjuro} that requires material components, puedes provide these material components without a conjuro component pouch by drawing intricate replacement sigils in the air.

Unlike when providing somatic components, tu still must have a mano completely free. Este doesn't remove the need for any materials listed in the conjuro's cost entry.

Kharnas's Lesser Glyph.name: Kharnas's Lesser Glyph
Kharnas's Lesser Glyph.description: A hidden glyph suddenly lights up y dominates the mind of any criatura not bearing the sigil of Kharnas the Angel-Binder.
Kharnas's Lesser Glyph.disable: Disable @Check[thievery|dc:46|name:Destroy Glyph|traits:action:disable-a-device] (legendario) to destroy the glyph, @Check[arcana|dc:42|name:Divert Glyph's Power] (maestro) to harmlessly divert the glyph's power, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (7th rank; counteract DC 38) to counteract the glyph
Kharnas's Lesser Glyph.reset: The glyph can affect two criaturas before it deactivates for 5 minutes y automatically resets.

action->Dominate.name: Dominar
action->Dominate.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura who doesn't bear the sigil of Kharnas attempts to open the door

Efecto A surge of the Radiant Spark's latent power courses through the glyph y washes over the triggering criatura. If the criatura is undead, it takes @Damage[10d10[vitality]] daño. If it's living, it instead regains @Damage[10d10[healing]] Puntos de Golpe. It then debe tener exito en una @Check[will|dc:40|traits:incapacitation,mental] salvacion or be affected by a 6th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]{Dominate} conjuro.

The conjuro commands the affected criatura to attack the nearest criatura who doesn't bear the sigil of Kharnas.

equipment->Standard Skeleton Key.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.fprUZviW8khm2BLo]
Standard Skeleton Key
equipment->Standard Skeleton Key.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.fprUZviW8khm2BLo]

A grinning skull tops the bow of this macabre key. Este key can be used in place of thieves' tools when attempting to PICK A LOCK, y it grants a +1 bonificador por objeto to the THIEVERY check.

If the skeleton key becomes broken due to a critical failure on the check, it works as normal thieves' tools y loses its benefits until repaired.

Activar F Interactuar

Frecuencia una vez al dia

Desencadenante Intentas to PICK A LOCK but haven't rolled yet

Efecto El key casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6Ot4N22t5tPD51BO]{Knock} on the lock estas trying to pick.

action->Scurry.name: Scurry
action->Scurry.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura ends its movement adjacent to Kolo

Efecto Kolo Steps.

action->Upward Stab.name: Upward Stab
action->Upward Stab.description: Kolo's melee Golpes deal an extra 1d6 daño de precision to Medium or larger criaturas.

Lie-Master.name: Maestro de mentiras
Lie-Master.publicNotes: Los glabrezus son colosos imponentes que se deleitan retorciendo los deseos mortales hasta convertirlos en ruina definitiva, traicionando y manipulando con la misma facilidad con la que respiran. Los deseos concedidos por un glabrezu siempre llegan a cumplirse de la forma más destructiva posible, dejando a sus víctimas con lo que pidieron y nada de lo que realmente necesitaban.
Lie-Master.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

spell->True Seeing.name:

<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tsKnoBuBbKMXkiz5]
Abyssal Pact

consumable->Black Dragon's Breath Potion.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LR7Ke2V8vHjQYBni]

Este liquid contains blood from a black dragon. For 1 hora after tu imbibe the concoction, puedes unleash a black dragon's breath arma. The potency of the breath depends on the potion's type, based on the age of the dragon whose blood was used to make the potion.

Exhaling dragon breath uses a single action. Creas a @Template[line|distance:30] of acid which inflige @Damage[10d6[acid]|options:area-damage] daño. All criaturas in the area debe intentar una @Check[reflex|dc:37|basic|options:area-effect] salvacion.

After tu use the breath arma, puedes't do so again for [[/r 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Truth Vulnerability.name: Truth Vulnerability
action->Truth Vulnerability.description: A glabrezu's lies sustain them, y the truth can destroy them. Siempre que a revelation effect counteracts or reveals the glabrezu's illusions or the glabrezu fails a save against an effect that would prevent them from lying (such as zone of truth), the demon takes @Damage[(3d6+4)[mental]] daño. They take this daño only once per effect, even if the effect reveals multiple illusions or prevents multiple lies.

action->Captive Rake.name: Captive Rake
action->Captive Rake.description:
Requisitos A criatura is grabbed in the glabrezu's pincer.

Efecto El glabrezu pulls the grabbed criatura up to 5 pies closer, then makes two claw Golpes against it. Those Golpes count as one attack when determining a treachery demon's multiple attack penalizador, y the penalizador doesn't increase until after both Golpes.

action->Steady Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros firme
action->Steady Spellcasting.description: When a reaction would disrupt a glabrezu's conjuro, the demon can intentar una @Check[flat|dc:17] check, avoiding the disruption on a success.

action->Sudden Betrayal.name: Sudden Betrayal
action->Sudden Betrayal.description: A glabrezu can always use DECEPTION when rolling initiative as long as they're aware of at least one opponent before initiative is rolled. When using DECEPTION for initiative, the demon gains a +2 bonificador por circunstancia to DECEPTION.

action->Tentacle Trip.name: Tentacle Trip
action->Tentacle Trip.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura a 15 pies o menos of the lie-maestro uses a manipulate or move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using

Efecto El criatura debe tener exito en una @Check[reflex|dc:34] salvacion or be knocked prone by the lie-maestro's clockwork tentacles.

action->Treacherous Veil.name: Treacherous Veil
action->Treacherous Veil.description: A glabrezu's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise} can allow it to appear as a criatura of any size.

action->Twisted Desires.name: Twisted Desires
action->Twisted Desires.description: Once per month, a glabrezu can grant a mortal humanoid the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YfJTXyVGzLhM6V8U]{Miracle} conjuro granted by an Abyssal patron, though the glabrezu always perverts the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YfJTXyVGzLhM6V8U]{Miracle} according to their own treacherous NATURE.

action->Grab.name: Agarrón
action->Grab.description:
Requisitos El monster's last action was a success with a Golpe that lists GRAB in its daño entry, or it has a criatura grabbed using this action.

Efecto El monster automatically Grabs el objetivo hasta el final de the monster's next turn. The criatura is grabbed by whichever body part the monster attacked with, y that body part can't be used to Golpe criaturas until the GRAB is ended. Using GRAB extends the duration of the monster's GRAB until el final de su siguiente turno for all criaturas grabbed by it. A grabbed criatura can use the Escape action to get out of the GRAB, y the GRAB ends for a grabbed criaturas if the monster moves away from it.

Life Magnet.name: Life Magnet
Life Magnet.description: A magical magnet hidden behind a panel in the corner of the room pulls not metal but criatura vivas toward it, heedless of any obstacles in the way.
Life Magnet.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:29|name:Deactivate Panel|traits:action:disable-a-device] (experto) to deactivate the panel, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (4th rank; counteract DC 22) to counteract the panel's magic
Life Magnet.reset: La trampa deactivates y resets 1 minuto after there are no criaturas touching the iron bars.
Life Magnet.routine:
(1 action) La trampa pulls up to four criaturas that have already triggered its Magnetize the Living ability toward one of the far corners of the room, possibly pressing them into the iron bars. If all the iron bars between an affected criatura y the magnetic panel remain intact, the criatura takes @Damage[(2d10+10)[contundente]] daño with a @Check[fortitude|dc:25|basic|options:inflicts:restrained] salvacion y is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} on a failure ([[/act escape dc=23]]).

If an iron bar has been broken, the criatura takes @Damage[(1d10+5)[contundente]] daño instead, y if two consecutive bars have been broken the criatura takes no daño (but might still be restrained on a failed save).

action->Magnetize the Living.name: Magnetize the Living
action->Magnetize the Living.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura touches any of the iron bars in this area or touches a criatura already affected by the trap

Efecto El magical panel hidden in the far corner of the chamber (either the western or the eastern corner, depending on which side of the room the criatura was closest to when it triggered the trap) "magnetizes" the triggering criatura y violently pulls it toward the corner, automatically dealing @Damage[(2d10+10)[contundente]] daño to the criatura.

La trampa then rolls initiative if it hasn't already done so.

action->Backdrop.name: Backdrop
action->Backdrop.description: When a criatura attempts to Golpe a living mural y critically misses, the attacker hits the surface (a wall, canvas, or so on) behind the living mural. Este can daño or break the arma or surface.

action->Surface-Bound.name: Surface-Bound
action->Surface-Bound.description:
A living mural can move only along flat surfaces such as floors y walls. Este allows it to end its movement wrapped around corners when on a continuous surface.

If the surface it's on is destroyed (such as a portrait hit by a fireball conjuro or a puddle being splashed), the mural takes @Damage[10d6[untyped]] daño y is shunted to the nearest flat surface. If there is no flat surface a 5 pies o menos, the living mural is destroyed.

action->Collective Attack.name: Collective Attack
action->Collective Attack.description:
The subjects depicted within the living mural all reach out at once to attack. The living mural makes a fist Golpe against each target within range.

Estos attacks count toward the living mural's multiple attack penalizador, but this penalizador doesn't increase until after all of the attacks are made.

action->Paint the Masses.name: Paint the Masses
action->Paint the Masses.description:
The living mural expels a @Template[cone|distance:15] of paint.

Las criaturas in the area debe tener exito en una @Check[reflex|dc:41] salvacion or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} durante 1 asalto.

The living mural can't use Paint the Masses again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Paint the Masses]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Splash of Color.name: Splash of Color
action->Splash of Color.description: When the living mural hits with a splatter attack, el objetivo is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} durante 1 asalto.

Living Paints.name: Pinturas vivientes
Living Paints.description: A mass of brushes use magical paint to convert criaturas into art.
Living Paints.disable: @Check[crafting|dc:41|name:Crafting Disable] (maestro) to mix the paints into bland, useless colors, @Check[thievery|dc:41|name:Thievery Disable] (legendario) to dismantle the animated brushes, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (8th rank; counteract DC 41) to counteract the magic within the paint.

action->Capture Subject.name: Capture Subject
action->Capture Subject.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura steps into the same space as the paints

Efecto El brushes animate y attempt to paint all criaturas a 30 pies o menos. The criaturas debe tener exito en una @Check[reflex|dc:41] salvacion to avoid the brushes y splashes from paint cans or be converted into living artwork durante 1 hora.

A criatura that becomes living artwork is immediately bound to the nearest flat surface of its size or larger a 30 pies o menos. The criatura can move only along flat surfaces such as floors y walls. Este allows it to end its movement wrapped around corners when on a continuous surface.

While bound to a surface, the criatura can attack from its space as normal, including against other criaturas bound to the same surface.

If the surface it's on is destroyed (such as a portrait hit by a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{Fireball} conjuro or a wall being demolished), the criatura takes @Damage[10d6[untyped]] daño y is shunted to the nearest flat surface. If there is no flat surface a 5 pies o menos, the criatura is destroyed.

Living Paints.publicNotes: Las pinturas vivientes usan pintura magica para convertir criaturas en arte.

weapon->+3 Greater Striking speed Handwr.name: +3 Greater Striking speed Handwraps of Mighty Blows

action->Attack of Opportunity.name: Ataque de oportunidad
action->Attack of Opportunity.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura al alcance del monstruo usa una accion de manipular o una accion de movimiento, realiza un ataque a distancia o abandona una casilla durante una accion de movimiento que esta usando.

Efecto El monstruo intenta un Golpe cuerpo a cuerpo contra la criatura desencadenante. Si el ataque es un impacto critico y el desencadenante fue una accion de manipular, el monstruo interrumpe esa accion. Este Golpe no cuenta para el penalizador por ataques multiples del monstruo, y su penalizador por ataques multiples no se aplica a este Golpe.

action->Double Punch.name: Double Punch
action->Double Punch.description: Lord Guirden makes two fist Golpes, ignoring the multiple attack penalizador until after both Golpes.

action->Hurl.name: Hurl
action->Hurl.description:
Requisitos Lord Guirden has a Medium or smaller criatura grabbed

Efecto Lord Guirden hurls the grabbed criatura into a target adjacent to him. He makes a fist Golpe against the adjacent target. Con un exito, el objetivo y hurled criatura both take 3d10+14 daño contundente y are knocked prone. On a failure, only the thrown criatura takes the daño y is knocked prone.

action->Master Brawler.name: Master Brawler
action->Master Brawler.description: Siempre que Lord Guirden makes a fist Golpe y hits, he can elige to apply either the GRAB, Knockdown, or Push ability to his attack.

Lusca.name: Lusca
Lusca.publicNotes: Una lusca es un monstruo marino depredador que se asemeja a un tiburon de tres cabezas con cuerpo de pulpo. Feroces tormentas electricas suelen anunciar su llegada; esas violentas descargas se originan en la fisiologia superconductora de la criatura y en la turbulencia que genera al moverse por aguas profundas.

action->Attack of Opportunity.name: Ataque de oportunidad
action->Attack of Opportunity.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura al alcance del monstruo usa una accion de manipular o una accion de movimiento, realiza un ataque a distancia o abandona una casilla durante una accion de movimiento que esta usando.

Efecto El monstruo intenta un Golpe cuerpo a cuerpo contra la criatura desencadenante. Si el ataque es un impacto critico y el desencadenante fue una accion de manipular, el monstruo interrumpe esa accion. Este Golpe no cuenta para el penalizador por ataques multiples del monstruo, y su penalizador por ataques multiples no se aplica a este Golpe.

action->Blood Scent.name: Blood Scent
action->Blood Scent.description: El lusca puede smell sangre en el agua up a 1 mile away.

action->Storm Bringer.name: Storm Bringer
action->Storm Bringer.description: Cuando el lusca es near el surface for more than 1 hora, clouds appear y deliver un thunderstorm con un 2-mile radius centered en su location. El weather returns a normal 1 hora after el lusca departs.

action->Capsize.name: Capsize
action->Capsize.description: The lusca tries to capsize an adjacent aquatic vessel of its size or smaller. It debe tener exito en unan ATHLETICS check with a DC of 35 (reduced by 5 for each size smaller the vessel is than the lusca) or the pilot's Sailing LORE DC, whichever is higher.

action->Lusca Venom.name: Lusca Venom
action->Lusca Venom.description:
Tirada de salvacion @Check[fortitude|dc:38]

Duración máxima 6 asaltos

Etapa 1 4d6 daño de veneno y torpe 1 (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 6d6 daño de veneno y torpe 2 (1 asalto)

action->Ravenous Jaws.name: Ravenous Jaws
action->Ravenous Jaws.description: The lusca makes three jaws Golpes, each against a different target. Estos attacks count toward the lusca's multiple attack penalizador, but the penalizador doesn't increase until after the lusca makes all of these attacks. If the lusca subsequently uses the GRAB action, it Grabs any number of criaturas it hit with Ravenous Jaws.

Maurrisa Jonne.name: Maurrisa Jonne
Maurrisa Jonne.saveDetails: +1 bonificador de estado to saves vs. incapacitation effects, +2 bonificador de estado to saves vs. Shove y Trip

weapon->+1 Striking Handwraps of Mighty.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.FNDq4NFSN0g2HKWO]
+1 Striking Handwraps of Mighty Blows

action->+1 Status Bonus on Saves vs. Inc.name: +1 Status Bonus on Saves vs. Incapacitation Effects

action->+2 Status Bonus on Saves vs. Sho.name: +2 Status Bonus on Saves vs. Shove

action->+2 Status Bonus on Saves vs. Tri.name: +2 Status Bonus on Saves vs. Trip

action->Duck and Weave.name: Duck y Weave
action->Duck and Weave.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura misses two consecutive melee Golpes against Maurrisa

Efecto Maurrisa sufre undvantage of a flailing foe's opening. She can either Dar un paso 5 pies or make a melee Golpe against the triggering criatura.

action->Rabbit Punch.name: Rabbit Punch
action->Rabbit Punch.description:
Desencadenante Maurrisa can make an Attack of Opportunity

Efecto Maurrisa chops her opponent on the back of the head or neck, possibly concussing them.

El objetivo debe intentar una @Check[fortitude|dc:26] salvacion. On a failure, the criatura sufre daño as if hit by Maurrisa's fist Golpe, y is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 1}. Con un fallo critico, the criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 3} instead.

spell->Tongues (Constant).name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SwUiVavHKMWG7t5K]
Tongues (Constant)

action->Fast Swallow.name: Tragar rápido
action->Fast Swallow.description:
Desencadenante El minchgorm Grabs a criatura in its jaws

Efecto El minchgorm uses Swallow Whole.

action->Riptide.name: Aguas revueltas
action->Riptide.description: Tentacles of water rise up y attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} all enemies a 15 pies o menos of the minchgorm. The minchgorm attempts an @Check[athletics] check against the Fortitude DC of each criatura in the area. Con un exito, the criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado} (Escape DC 40). Con un exito critico, or a success against a criatura that is already grabbed, el objetivo begins to drown.

action->Watery Simulacra.name: Watery Simulacra
action->Watery Simulacra.description: The minchgorm raises up to eight figures from nearby water, each appearing in an empty space within 60 pies of the minchgorm. A simulacrum can take any shape of size Medium or smaller that the minchgorm desires, including that of a specific individual or object, but is always plainly made of water. The minchgorm can speak, cast conjuros, y use its senses through its simulacra, spending actions for a simulacrum on a one-for-one basis. By using a single action with the concentrate rasgo, the minchgorm can cause any number of simulacra to Volar, Dar un paso, Zancada, or Swim up to 60 pies. A simulacrum uses the minchgorm's AC y tiradas de salvacion y has 30 Puntos de Golpe. A minchgorm can have up to eight simulacra in existence at once. Simulacra dissolve immediately when more than 60 pies from the minchgorm, or if the minchgorm dies or falls unconscious. The minchgorm can dismiss any number of its simulacra as a free action.

Miogimo.name: Miogimo
Miogimo.saveDetails: +1 bonificador de estado to Will saves vs. mental effects

spell->Freedom of Movement.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aqRYNoSvxsVfqglH]
Freedom of Movement

spell->Veil.name: Velo
spell->Veil.description:
Tu disguise the targets as other criaturas of the same body shape y roughly similar height (within 6 inches) y weight (within 50 pounds). The disguise can hide the targets' identities or let them appear to be of another ancestry, but it's not precise enough to impersonate specific individuals. The conjuro doesn't change voice, scent, or mannerisms. Tu elige the disguise for each target; for example, tu could make one target appear to be a dwarf y another an elf. Casting veil counts as setting up a disguise for the purpose of the Impersonate action. It allows el objetivo to ignore any circumstance penalties they might take for being disguised as dissimilar criaturas, y it gives the targets a +4 bonificador de estado to DECEPTION checks to prevent others from seeing through their disguises, y add their level even if untrained. Puedes Dismiss any or all of these disguises.

Heightened (5th) The conjuro also disguises the targets' voices y scents; it gains the auditory y olfactory rasgos.

Heightened (7th) The targets can appear as any criatura of the same size, even specific individuals. Debes have seen an individual to reproduce their appearance. The conjuro also disguises the targets' voices y scents; it gains the auditory y olfactory rasgos.

spell->Geas.target: 1 criatura de nivel no superior al doble del nivel del ritual geas

spell->Illusory Creature (At Will).name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]
Criatura ilusoria (a voluntad)

action->Little Favors.name: Little Favors
action->Little Favors.description: Each time a criatura willingly performs a service, quest, or task for the zealborn, the criatura sufre un cumulative -1 penalizador de estado a las tiradas de salvacion against the zealborn's mental conjuros y abilities (maximum -4).

action->+1 Status to Will Saves vs. Ment.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.kquBnQ0kObZztnBc]
+1 Status to Will Saves vs. Mental

action->Rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenecimiento
action->Rejuvenation.description: When Miogimo is destroyed, he re-forms, fully healed, near a follower of his choice in [[/gmr 1d10 #Rejuvenation]]{1d10 days}. For the purposes of rejuvenation, a follower is defined as an intelligent criatura who's well acquainted with Miogimo y is a true believer in Miogimo's mission, not merely a lukewarm supporter. Miogimo can be permanently destroyed only if he has no current followers or can be convinced to end his own life.

action->Trickster's Ace.description:

action->Zealous Restoration.name: Zealous Restoration
action->Zealous Restoration.description: Miogimo can't regain Puntos de Golpe through resting or curación de vacío; he feeds only on the idealism of his supporters, regaining 10 Puntos de Golpe per day for each criatura under the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Q690d3mw3TUrKX7E]{Geas} cast by Miogimo. Las criaturas under Miogimo's geas have their maximum HP reduced by 10 each day until they are burned away to a husk y perish. After 24 horas, such criaturas rise as zeal-damned ghouls under Miogimo's control. Zeal-damned ghouls eat only the flesh of evil or chaotic criaturas y deal an additional 1d6 spirit y 1d6 daño de vacio with their attacks.

action->Spit.description: A criatura hit by Mother Venom's spit attack is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizado} y stuck to the nearest surface (Escape DC 38).

Mr. Snips.name: Sr. Tijeras
Mr. Snips.publicNotes: Tradicionalmente fabricados con forma de enormes armaduras o animales poderosos, los golems de hierro son productos de arte y habilidad exquisitos. Sus articulaciones y cuerpos acorazados requieren gran cuidado y precision matematica para moverse con la fuerza implacable que los caracteriza.

action->Golem Antimagic.name: Golem Antimagic
action->Golem Antimagic.description:
Harmed by acid (@Damage[(6d10+4)[untyped]], @Damage[(2d8+4)[untyped]] from areas y daño persistente); healed by fire (area @Damage[(2d8+4)[healing]] HP); ralentizado by electricity

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.GolemAntimagic]

action->Vulnerable to Neutralize Poison.name: Vulnerable to Neutralize Poison
action->Vulnerable to Neutralize Poison.description: Casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction} en el golem deactivates su Breath arma durante 1 minuto.

action->Vulnerable to Rust.name: Vulnerable to Rust
action->Vulnerable to Rust.description: Los efectos magicos de oxidacion, como las antenas de un monstruo de oxido, afectan al golem de hierro con normalidad.

action->Breath Weapon.name: Arma de aliento
action->Breath Weapon.description:
The iron golem exhales poisonous gas in a @Template[burst|distance:10]{10-pies radius} centered on the corner of one of the iron golem's squares.

The gas persists durante 1 asalto. Any criatura in the area (or that later enters the area) is exposed to the iron golem's poison.

The golem can't use its Arma de aliento again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Dismember.name: Dismember
action->Dismember.description:
Siempre que Mr. Snips rolls a impacto critico with a scissors Golpe, in addition to dealing daño adicional, the golem has a chance to dismember its victim. El objetivo must roll a @Check[reflex|dc:39|traits:damaging-effect] salvacion.

Éxito No additional effect.

Fallo El objetivo sufre @Damage[2d10[bleed]].

Fallo critico As failure, y one of the targets extremities is severed (the effects of this are up to the GM's discretion).

action->Inexorable March.name: Inexorable March
action->Inexorable March.description: The iron golem Strides up to its Velocidad, pushing back each criatura whose space it moves into y damaging them if they try to stop its movement. A criatura can attempt to bar the way by succeeding at a @Check[fortitude|dc:39] salvacion. Con un exito critico, the resisting criatura takes no daño; otherwise, it is damaged as if hit by the golem's fist.

action->Iron Golem Poison.description:

equipment->Cloak of the Bat (Greater).description:
Sewn from several long strips of luxurious brown y black silk, this cloak grants tu a +3 bonificador por objeto to STEALTH checks as well as to Acrobatics checks to Maneuver in Flight. Puedes also use tu pies to hang from any surface that can support tu weight, without requiring any check, though tu still must attempt ATHLETICS checks to CLIMB in order to move around while inverted.

Activar 2 command, Interactuar

Frecuencia any number of times per day

Efecto Puedes either transform the cloak into bat-like wings that grant tu a volar Velocidad of 30 pies durante 10 minutos, or have the cloak turn tu into a bat by casting a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gfPjmG6Fe6D3MFjl]{Pest Form} conjuro on tu.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.ioGzmVSmMGXWWBYb]{Efecto: Cloak of the Bat}

0.label: Cloak of the Bat, Maneuver in Flight

equipment->Heartstone.description:
Este gemstone grants its wearer a +2 bonificador por objeto a las tiradas de salvacion.

Each heartstone is powered by the spirit of a specific night hag. If it's separated from her durante 24 horas (or she's been dead durante 24 horas), it becomes a nonmagical gemstone. A heartstone allows the hag to use additional occult innate conjuros: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.D2nPKbIS67m9199U]{Ethereal Jaunt} (9th level) y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GYmXvS9NJ7QwfWGg]{Seize Soul} at will, y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IqJ9URobmJ9L9UBG]{Shadow Blast} twice per day.

Activar A command

Requisitos Debes be touching the heartstone.

Efecto El heartstone attempts to counteract one disease affecting tu (counteract rank 5, counteract modifier +18).

Requisitos de fabricación Debes be a night hag.

action->Nightmare Rider.name: Nightmare Rider
action->Nightmare Rider.description: When a night hag rides a nightmare, the nightmare also gains the night hag's bonificador de estado to saves against magic, y both the hag y rider benefit when the night hag uses her heartstone's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.D2nPKbIS67m9199U]{Ethereal Jaunt} innate conjuro.

action->Planar Coven.name: Planar Coven
action->Planar Coven.description: As long as at least one other member of Myrna's coven is on the demiplane of Stormholt, the coven members add chain lightning, lightning bolt, plane shift, y punishing winds to their conjuros, each of which can be cast at up to 8th level.

action->Abyssal Plague.name: Plaga Abisal
action->Abyssal Plague.description:
A criatura can't recover from drained until Abyssal plague is cured

Tirada de salvacion @Check[fortitude|dc:41]

Etapa 1 drained 1 (1 día)

Etapa 2 drained 3 (1 día)

action->Change Shape.name: Cambiar de forma
action->Change Shape.description:
The night hag can take on the appearance of any Medium female humanoid. Este doesn't change her Velocidad or her attack y daño bonuses with her Golpes, but might change the tipo de daño her Golpes deal (typically to contundente).

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

action->Dream Haunting.name: Dream Haunting
action->Dream Haunting.description: If a night hag is ethereal y hovering over a sleeping chaotic or evil criatura, she can ride the victim's back until dawn. The criatura endures tormenting dreams as the hag casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Uqj344bezBq3ESdq]{Nightmare} on it, y is exposed to abyssal plague. Any drained caused by dream haunting is cumulative. Only an ethereal being can confront the night hag y stop her dream haunting.

action->Spell Ambush.description: A criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to the night hag sufre un -2 penalizador por circunstancia to checks y DCs to defend against her conjuros.

action->Odorless.description: Un myrucarx emits no smell y puede't be detected by olfato.

action->Painful Light.name: Painful Light
action->Painful Light.description: Cuando attempting un salvacion against un light effect, un myrucarx gets un result one degree de success lower than ello rolled. Un myrucarx caught en sunlight es @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2} y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}.

action->Illusory Persona.name: Illusory Persona
action->Illusory Persona.description: The illusion created by the myrucarx's project image can resemble any Medium humanoid, including any specific individual it has seen, y has appropriate voice, scent, y mannerisms, allowing the myrucarx to use its DECEPTION check to Impersonate that humanoid if it chooses.

action->Twisting Reach.name: Twisting Reach
action->Twisting Reach.description:
Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Efecto El fanged mouths at the ends of a myrucarx's tendrils twist around obstacles. The myrucarx makes two jaws Golpes against the same target, ignoring la esencia del objetivo cover. Both attacks count toward the myrucarx's multiple attack penalizador, but the penalizador doesn't increase until after both attacks are made. The myrucarx can't GRAB as its next action after Twisting Reach.

action->Shared Diversion.name: Shared Diversion

Este delicate necklace contains bottled whispers distilled from a source on the Astral Plane rumored to be connected to the first lie ever told.

While wearing the necklace, obtienes a +3 bonificador por objeto to DECEPTION checks, y puedes attempt to counteract effects that would force tu to tell the truth or determine whether estas lying.

Puedes instead administer this elixir to a criatura that has been dead for a week or less. When tu do, that criatura is instantly brought back to life with 1 Hit Point y no conjuro slots, Focus Points, or other daily resources.

Requisitos de fabricación philosopher's stone, true elixir of life

An imentesh's Golpes deal an additional 4d6 daño de precision to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} targets.

action->Warpwave Strike.name: Warpwave Golpe
action->Warpwave Strike.description: Any criatura struck y damaged by an imentesh's jaws Golpe debe tener exito en una @Check[fortitude|dc:38] salvacion or be subject to a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.rollable-tables.RollTable.yRZwPolTnRdnz42V]{Warpwave}.

Pelmo.name: Pelmo
Pelmo.publicNotes: Los combatientes de primera linea de las tribus goblin prefieren luchar en grandes grupos, sobre todo cuando superan a sus enemigos al menos tres a uno. Estos pequenos humanoides tienen piel verde o gris y cabezas grandes con orejas anchas. Aunque algunos goblins son civilizados y se han esforzado por ser considerados miembros respetables de comunidades humanoides, la mayoria son criaturas impetuosas y crueles que disfrutan sembrando el caos. No dudan en sacrificar ganado, robar infantes o quemar un edificio solo por un instante de diversion. Se deleitan gastando bromas maliciosas a humanoides mas altos, a quienes llaman "patilargos".

weapon->Alchemist's Fire (Lesser).description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.yd3kEK21YknZLlcT]

Activar A Golpe

alchemist's fire is a combination of volatile liquids that ignite when exposed to air. alchemist's fire inflige 1d8 daño de fuego, 1 daño persistente de fuego, y 1 daño de salpicadura de fuego.

action->Goblin Scuttle.name: Huida goblin
action->Goblin Scuttle.description:
Desencadenante Una goblin ally ends a move action adjacent to Pelmo.

Efecto Pelmo @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.UHpkTuCtyaPqiCAB]{Steps}.

Penqual.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

Telepathy 100 pies

action->Easy to Call.name: Easy to Call
action->Easy to Call.description: El sahkil es considered 2 levels lower for el purposes de being summoned by rituals (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2ykmAVKrsAWcazcC]{Binding Circle}), but es always free a ataque o leave instead de negotiate unless el primary caster's prueba es un critical success.

action->Crowded Mob.name: Crowded Mob
action->Crowded Mob.description: The penqual is a swarm of Medium figures that can squeeze supernaturally close to other criaturas. Though its component criaturas are larger than those of a typical swarm, a penqual can nevertheless share the spaces of other criaturas.

action->Crush of Hundreds.name: Crush of Hundreds
action->Crush of Hundreds.description:
A criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado} by the sahkil's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.O6VQC1Bs4aSYDa6R]{Mask of Terror} feels the press of a suffocating crowd.

The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} y sufre un -10-pies penalizador to all Velocidades for as long as it is asustado.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.R8clbf7gtIlU3fIj]{Efecto: Crush of Hundreds}

action->Frantic Grasp.name: Frantic Grasp
action->Frantic Grasp.description: Each enemigo in the penqual's space takes @Damage[4d12[cortante]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:36|basic] salvacion).

action->Mob Rush.name: Mob Rush
action->Mob Rush.description: The penqual Strides twice, ignoring difficult terrain, y then uses Frantic Grasp. If it moves at least 20 pies away from its starting position, the DC of Frantic Grasp increases by 2.

action->Skip Between.name: Skip Between
action->Skip Between.description: El sahkil puede mover itself between el Ethereal Plane y el Material Plane, as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.D2nPKbIS67m9199U]{Ethereal Jaunt}, except que este ability tiene un unlimited duration y puede be Dismissed

action->Combustible.name: Combustible
action->Combustible.description: The first time each round that a pickled punk sufre daño de fuego, its fumes combust, dealing @Damage[5[fire]|options:area-damage] daño to all other criaturas within the area of its Suffocating Fumes aura.

action->Suffocating Fumes.name: Suffocating Fumes
action->Suffocating Fumes.description:
5 pies. A criatura that enters or begins its turn within the aura debe intentar una @Check[fortitude|dc:14] salvacion, or @Check[fortitude|dc:17] if the pickled punk is attached to the criatura.

On a failed save, the criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1}, y on a critical failure, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1} durante 1 minuto.

action->Attach.name: Attach
action->Attach.description:
When a pickled punk hits a target larger than itself, it uses bizarre excretions to adhere to that criatura. Este is similar to Grabbing the criatura, but the pickled punk is not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido}, y it moves with that criatura rather than holding it in place.

Each turn while attached, the pickled punk automatically inflige the daño from its jaws Golpe to the criatura to which it's attached. It also wriggles about, gaining a +2 bonificador por circunstancia to AC as long as it's not also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

Plunger Chute.name: Conducto de empuje
Plunger Chute.description: Un trapdoor en el suelo conceals un oculto chute, y un moviendose section de muro shoves victims into ello.
Plunger Chute.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:23|name:Jam the Trapdoor Shut|traits:action:disable-a-device] (experto) to jam the trapdoor shut or activate a hidden bypass switch by twisting a fitting on the gas lamp

action->Pitfall and Plunger.name: Pitfall y Plunger
action->Pitfall and Plunger.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura walks onto the trapdoor

Efecto Anyone within 10 pies of the room's northern wall falls 40 pies down the shaft to area E33, taking @Damage[20[contundente]|options:fall-daño] daño y landing @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} in the ochre jelly's pit.

The victims can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{GRAB an Edge} to avoid falling.

The DC to GRAB an Edge is 20; the DC to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{CLIMB} the walls is 22.

Plunger Chute.publicNotes: Una trampilla en el suelo oculta un conducto secreto, y una seccion movil de pared empuja a las victimas hacia el.

consumable->Giant Scorpion Venom.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.QGXNqpP5KvSldoZz]

Scorpion venom is excruciating y its effects are somewhat debilitating.

Activar 2 Interactuar (Injury)

Tirada de salvacion @Check[fortitude|dc:22]

Duración máxima 6 asaltos

Etapa 1 @Damage[1d10[poison]] daño y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1} (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 @Damage[2d10[poison]] daño y debilitado 1 (1 asalto)

Etapa 3 @Damage[2d10[poison]] daño y debilitado 2 (1 asalto)

action->Toxin-Inured.name: Toxin-Inured
action->Toxin-Inured.description: A poison eater can't gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto} condicion from poisons.

action->Consume Poison.name: Consume Poison
action->Consume Poison.description:
The poison eater uses an Interactuar action to draw a dose of poison y eats it, gaining strength.

The poison-eater's Golpes deal two arma dice of daño rather than one. The poison eater is affected by the consumed poison normally and, therefore, usually chooses poisons mitigated by their poison resistance y toxin-inured ability.

At the end of each of their turns, the poison eater attempts a @Check[flat|dc:17|name:Consumed Poison Metabolizes] check; on a success, this ability ends.

0.label: The Poison Eater has Consumed a Poison

action->Poison Frenzy.name: Poison Frenzy
action->Poison Frenzy.description:
Requisitos El poison eater isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigado} or already in a frenzy

Desencadenante the poison eater damages a criatura while Consume Poison is in effect

Efecto El poison eater flies into a frenzy that lasts durante 1 minuto. While in a frenzy, the poison eater gains a +1 bonificador de estado a las tiradas de ataque with melee Golpes, gains a +4 bonificador de estado to tiradas de daño with melee Golpes, gains 20 Puntos de Golpe temporales hasta el final de the frenzy, y sufre un -2 penalizador de estado to AC. The poison eater can't voluntarily end their frenzy. After their frenzy, the poison eater is fatigued.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.u2z1BgpZsxl7Zc2z]{Efecto: Poison Frenzy}

Poisoned Dart Statue.name: Estatua de dardos envenenados
Poisoned Dart Statue.description: Countless veneno darts fuego de holes en el statues y muros de este hall.
Poisoned Dart Statue.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:34|name:Disable Trap|traits:action:disable-a-device] (maestro) on the control panel deactivates the trap.
Poisoned Dart Statue.reset: La trampa deactivates y resets after 1 minuto.
Poisoned Dart Statue.routine: (1 action) La trampa launches one dart against every criatura in the hall as 1 action. Because it launches darts continuously, the trap can also use the Continuous Barrage free action (see below) to launch darts at each criatura during that criatura's turn. La trampa doesn't take a multiple attack penalizador.
Poisoned Dart Statue.stealth: (experto) or @Check[perception|dc:39|traits:action:seek] (maestro) to notice the control panel. Anyone specifically searching the name plate of Abresha Tallow-Hands locates the control panel automatically.

action->Dart Volley.name: Dart Volley
action->Dart Volley.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura makes noise in the hall, which can be avoided with a successful @Check[stealth|dc:28|name:Avoid Notice|traits:action:sneak,move,secret] check

Efecto La trampa makes a poisoned dart Golpe against the triggering criatura, then rolls initiative.

action->Continuous Barrage.name: Continuous Barrage
action->Continuous Barrage.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura within the hallway finishes an action while the trap is active

Efecto La trampa makes a poisoned dart Golpe against the triggering criatura.

action->Terinav Root Poison.name: Terinav Root Poison
action->Terinav Root Poison.description:
Tirada de salvacion @Check[fortitude|dc:28]

Duración máxima 6 asaltos

Etapa 1 4d6 daño de veneno y torpe 2 (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 5d6 daño de veneno, torpe 2, y –5-pies penalizador de estado to all Velocidades (1 asalto)

Etapa 3 7d6 daño de veneno, torpe 2, y –10-pies penalizador de estado to all Velocidades (1 asalto)

Poisoned Dart Statue.publicNotes: Incontables dardos envenenados salen disparados de agujeros en las estatuas y paredes de este pasillo.

spell->Freedom of Movement.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aqRYNoSvxsVfqglH]
Freedom of Movement

spell->Light.target: 1 objeto de Volumen 1 o menos, desatendido o en posesion tuya o de un aliado voluntario

equipment->Religious Symbol (norgorber).name: Religious Symbol (norgorber)
equipment->Religious Symbol (norgorber).description: Esta pieza de madera o plata está adornada con una imagen que representa un dios. Algunos lanzadores de conjuros divinos, como los clérigos, pueden utilizar un símbolo religioso de su dios como foco divino para utilizar ciertas habilidades y lanzar algunos conjuros. Se debe sostener un símbolo religioso en una mano para usarlo.

ammo->Arrows.name: Flechas
ammo->Arrows.description: Estos projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end y bears a metal head on the other.

ammo->Arrows With Shadow Essence.name: Arrows With Shadow Essence
ammo->Arrows With Shadow Essence.description:
Estos projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end y bears a metal head on the other.

infused with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Wjkw0lEUOhypYvzo]{Shadow Essence}

action->Attack of Opportunity.name: Ataque de oportunidad
action->Attack of Opportunity.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura al alcance del monstruo usa una accion de manipular o una accion de movimiento, realiza un ataque a distancia o abandona una casilla durante una accion de movimiento que esta usando.

Efecto El monstruo intenta un Golpe cuerpo a cuerpo contra la criatura desencadenante. Si el ataque es un impacto critico y el desencadenante fue una accion de manipular, el monstruo interrumpe esa accion. Este Golpe no cuenta para el penalizador por ataques multiples del monstruo, y su penalizador por ataques multiples no se aplica a este Golpe.

action->Toxic Mastery.name: Toxic Mastery
action->Toxic Mastery.description: Kalyn can masterfully manipulate vile, poisonous energy y increase its potency. Her melee y ranged Golpes deal an additional 2d6 daño de veneno, y a target that takes this daño de veneno has a -1 penalizador de estado a las tiradas de salvacion against Kalyn's divine conjuros durante 1 asalto. Poisons delivered by Kalyn have the virulent rasgo.

Prospecti Statue.name: Estatua de Prospecti
Prospecti Statue.acDetails: (22 cuando está roto); armadura de constructo
Prospecti Statue.publicNotes: Al igual que otras estatuas animadas humanoides de tamano Mediano, las estatuas animadas gigantes se usan para custodiar lugares importantes, pero su mayor tamano y poder las hacen mas utiles en grandes camaras acorazadas, salas espaciosas o ubicaciones exteriores. Los objetos animados de esta fuerza y tamano son ideales para tareas y responsabilidades que suelen encargarse a golems, y por ello los objetos animados mas poderosos son practicamente desconocidos.

weapon->+1 Longsword (Huge).name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LJdbVTOZog39EEbi]
+1 Longsword (Huge)
weapon->+1 Longsword (Huge).description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LJdbVTOZog39EEbi]

Las espadas largas pueden tener uno o dos filos. Sus hojas son pesadas y miden entre 3 y 4 pies de longitud.

action->Construct Armor (Hardness 10).name: Armadura de constructo (Dureza 10)
action->Construct Armor (Hardness 10).description: Como los objetos normales, a giant animated statue tiene Dureza. Esta Dureza reduce cualquier daño que reciba en una cantidad igual a la Dureza. Once a giant animated statue is reduced to less than half its Puntos de Golpe, o inmediatamente upon being damaged by a impacto critico, its armadura de constructo breaks y its ARMOR CLASS is reduced to 22.

action->Stone Robes.name: Stone Robes
action->Stone Robes.description:
The Prospecti statue turns suddenly, causing its robes, which flow like fabric despite being as hard as stone, to swing about y daño opponents.

Las criaturas adjacent to the animated statue take @Damage[(2d6+6)[contundente]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] salvacion; on a critical failure, the criatura is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}).

Pulping Golem.name: Golem triturador
Pulping Golem.publicNotes: Tradicionalmente fabricados con forma de enormes armaduras o animales poderosos, los golems de hierro son productos de arte y habilidad exquisitos. Sus articulaciones y cuerpos acorazados requieren gran cuidado y precision matematica para fabricarse, y la limpieza y lubricacion regulares aseguran que no se oxiden con el paso de los siglos. Con el cuidado adecuado, pueden permanecer en buen estado durante miles de anos, transmitiendose de generacion en generacion mientras no los destruyan aventureros entrometidos. Ademas de su fuerza increible, poseen un potente aliento toxico que a menudo basta para dispersar a sus enemigos.

action->Golem Antimagic.name: Golem Antimagic
action->Golem Antimagic.description:
Harmed by acid (@Damage[(6d10+4)[untyped]], @Damage[(2d8+4)[untyped]] from areas y daño persistente); healed by fire (area @Damage[(2d8+4)[healing]] HP); ralentizado by electricity

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.GolemAntimagic]

action->Vulnerable to Neutralize Poison.name: Vulnerable to Neutralize Poison
action->Vulnerable to Neutralize Poison.description: Casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction} en el golem deactivates su Breath arma durante 1 minuto.

action->Vulnerable to Rust.name: Vulnerable to Rust
action->Vulnerable to Rust.description: Los efectos magicos de oxidacion, como las antenas de un monstruo de oxido, afectan al golem de hierro con normalidad.

action->Breath Weapon.name: Arma de aliento
action->Breath Weapon.description:
The pulping golem spills its cauldron stomach to the floor, dealing @Damage[9d12[fire]|options:area-damage] daño to criaturas within 10 pies (@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic] salvacion).

It can't use Arma de aliento again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Extend Legs.name: Extend Legs
action->Extend Legs.description: The pulping golem extends its legs up to a height of 40 pies, raising its body high into the air. While its legs are extended, its movement speed is halved, y it sufre un -2 penalizador to its Fortitude save DC against @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} attempts.

action->Inexorable March.name: Inexorable March
action->Inexorable March.description: The iron golem Strides up to its Velocidad, pushing back each criatura whose space it moves into y damaging them if they try to stop its movement. A criatura can attempt to bar the way by succeeding at a @Check[fortitude|dc:39] salvacion. Con un exito critico, the resisting criatura takes no daño; otherwise, it is damaged as if hit by the golem's fist.

action->Iron Golem Poison.name: Iron Golem Poison
action->Iron Golem Poison.description:
Any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado} value from this poison is reduced by 1 every hour.

Tirada de salvacion @Check[fortitude|dc:35]

Duración máxima 4 asaltos

Etapa 1 2d6+4 poison y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 1} (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 4d6+4 poison y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 2} (1 asalto)

Etapa 3 8d6+4 poison y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 3} (1 asalto).

equipment->Ring of Discretion.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.FABVnBeYtGXshlwm]

Este ring magically conceals any armor y sheathed armas estas wearing by either turning them invisible or creating the illusion of ordinary clothes. The ring doesn't change tu appearance beyond concealing armas y armor. As soon as tu wield a arma, the arma becomes obvious to onlookers y is no longer affected by the ring until tu sheathe the arma for at least 1 minuto. A criatura can disbelieve this illusion by Seeking or any time it hits tu with an attack.

consumable->Healing Potion (Lesser).description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.e0vSAQfxhHauiAoD]

A healing potion is a vial of a ruby-red liquid that imparts a tingling sensation as the drinker's wounds heal rapidly. When tu drink a healing potion, tu regain @Damage[(2d8+5)[healing]] Puntos de Golpe.

action->Double Stab.name: Double Stab
action->Double Stab.description:
Requisitos Ralso is wielding two perforante armas

Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Efecto Ralso makes two Golpes against a single criatura within reach, one Golpe per arma.

Estos attacks count toward Ralso's multiple attack penalizador, but the penalizador doesn't increase until after both attacks.

action->Sneak Attack.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.AWvNPE4U0kEJSL1T]

Ralso inflige an extra 1d6 daño de precision to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} criaturas.

action->Regeneration 20 (Deactivated by.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.lR9R5Vld8Eu2Dha5]
Regeneración 20 (Deactivated by Fire or Acid)

action->Deep Breath.name: Contener La Respiración
action->Deep Breath.description: Un ravenile puede contener la respiracion for 20 minutos.

action->Forced Regeneration.name: Forced Regeneración
action->Forced Regeneration.description:
Requisitos El ravenile's regeneration is currently active

The ravenile regains @Damage[20[healing]] HP.

action->Furious Wallop.name: Furious Wallop
action->Furious Wallop.description:
Requisitos El ravenile's regeneration is currently deactivated

Efecto El ravenile makes a melee Golpe.

Este counts as two attacks for the ravenile's multiple attack penalizador.

If this Golpe hits, the ravenile inflige an extra die of daño del arma y el objetivo falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}.

action->Rend.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.3JOi2cMcGhT3eze1]

Claw

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Rend]

Reginald Vancaskerkin.name: Reginald Vancaskerkin

action->Clockwork Reconstruction.name: Clockwork Reconstruction
action->Clockwork Reconstruction.description: Each time Reginald is reborn in his lair, his machines graft him with a new clockwork modification. He chooses one of his abilities with the clockwork rasgo. He gains access to this ability but can't use any of his other clockwork abilities. He can't elige the same ability twice in a row. He begins with Ink Blood active.

action->Ink Blood.name: Ink Blood
action->Ink Blood.description:
Reginald's body is filled with toxic ink

Desencadenante Unan adjacent criatura Golpes Reginald with a melee arma or ataque sin armas y inflige daño

Efecto El criatura is exposed to Reginald's poison ink.

action->Secret of Rebirth.name: Secret of Rebirth
action->Secret of Rebirth.description: If a criatura with less than 5 Secret Knowledge points reduces Reginald to 0 HP (or dealt the last daño to him before he dies from using Overdrive Engine), Reginald's body dissipates into a puddle of ink y releases a black wave of psychic energy. Each criatura a 30 pies o menos is bathed in a torrent of forbidden secrets y gains 1 Secret Knowledge point. Reginald's body reforms [[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6 rounds} later in his sanctum at full health at a location of his choosing (typically the Pool of Secrets, area L11). Este ability activates automatically with no action necessary on Vancaskerkin's behalf.

action->Breath Weapon.name: Arma de aliento
action->Breath Weapon.description: Reginald's lungs are equipped with ink canisters, allowing him to spew a @Template[line|distance:60] of ink that inflige @Damage[9d6[poison]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:39|basic|options:area-effect] salvacion; on a failure, the criatura is also subjected to Reginald's poison ink).

action->Overdrive Engine.name: Overdrive Engine
action->Overdrive Engine.description:
Reginald is equipped with clockwork organs to power his body

Requisitos Reginald has 175 Puntos de Golpe or fewer

Efecto Reginald gains 200 Puntos de Golpe temporales, a +15-pies bonificador de estado to Velocidad, y a +2 bonificador de estado to melee tiradas de ataque. His body begins to overheat, spewing steam that inflige @Damage[9d6[fire]|options:area-damage] daño at the beginning of his turn to all criaturas within @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 pies} (@Check[reflex|dc:40|basic|options:area-effect] salvacion). After 2 asaltos, Reginald explodes, dealing @Damage[19d6[fire]] daño to all criaturas within @Template[emanation|distance:60]{60 pies} (@Check[reflex|dc:40|basic] salvacion). Reginald dies. For the purposes of his Secret of Rebirth ability, the last criatura to daño Reginald counts as killing him.

action->Poison Ink.name: Poison Ink
action->Poison Ink.description:
Reginald is immune to the toxic ink that flows through his veins

Tirada de salvacion @Check[fortitude|dc:38]

Duración máxima 10 asaltos

Etapa 1 @Damage[3d6[poison]] y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1} (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 @Damage[4d6[poison]] @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 2} (1 asalto).

action->Quill Cannon.name: Quill Cannon
action->Quill Cannon.description: Reginald is equipped with a cannon y hundreds of steel quills. He makes two steel quill attacks against every criatura in a @Template[cone|distance:60], ignoring the multiple attack penalizador until after all attacks are made. He can't use Quill Cannon again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Quill Cannon]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Reflective Plating.name: Reflective Plating
action->Reflective Plating.description: Reginald engages su defensive plating, que casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OOELvfkTedBMlWtq]{Spell Turning} en him (counteract modifier +32).

action->Slither.name: Culebrear
action->Slither.description: With his body composed of ink y gears, Reginald can move through tight spaces as if he were a Tiny criatura, treating them as difficult terrain.

Reginald Vancaskerkin.publicNotes: Cada vez que Reginald renace en su guarida, sus maquinas le injertan una nueva modificacion mecanica. Elige una de sus aptitudes con el rasgo mecanico. Gana acceso a esa aptitud, pero no puede usar ninguna de sus otras aptitudes mecanicas hasta que vuelva a renacer y sus maquinas lo reconstruyan otra vez.

action->Plunder Life.description:
60 pies. When a healing effect restores Puntos de Golpe to a non-fiend criatura in the aura, the amount of Puntos de Golpe restored is halved. The rhevanna gains Puntos de Golpe temporales equal to the amount of Puntos de Golpe restored.

The rhevanna loses any remaining Puntos de Golpe temporales after 1 minuto.

action->Detaining Strike.name: Detaining Golpe
action->Detaining Strike.description:
Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Desencadenante El rhevanna hits a criatura with a arma Golpe

Efecto El rhevanna casts an innate @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ksLCg62cLOojw3gN]{Planar Tether} conjuro on the criatura.

action->Lifedrinker.name: Lifedrinker
action->Lifedrinker.description:
Desencadenante El rhevanna kills a criatura viva of at least 16th level

Efecto El rhevanna drinks the triggering criatura's life force y regains @Damage[40[healing]] Puntos de Golpe. If the triggering criatura is a celestial, the rhevanna instead regains @Damage[80[healing]] Puntos de Golpe.

action->Malefic Binding.name: Malefic Binding
action->Malefic Binding.description:
El rhevanna puede objetivo celestials con su @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GYmXvS9NJ7QwfWGg]{Seize Soul} ability, y un gem containing un celestial bound by un rhevanna tiene Dureza 40.

Si el rhevanna destroys un gem en que ellos placed un celestial, el celestial es destruido forever.

Rigged Cubby.name: Rigged Cubby
Rigged Cubby.description: Un oculto string connected a precariously stacked bricks causes el cubby a collapse en en itself cuando el string es pulled.
Rigged Cubby.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:20|name:Cut String|traits:action:disable-a-device] a cut el string sin setting off el trampa

action->Collapse.name: Desplome
action->Collapse.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura touches the sickle in the cubby

Efecto El heavy bricks above the cubby collapse, leaving the sickle unscathed but dealing @Damage[(4d6+10)[contundente]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic] salvacion) to the triggering criatura.

weapon->+2 Greater Striking War Razor.name: +2 Greater Striking War Razor
weapon->+2 Greater Striking War Razor.description: A war razor is an exaggerated version of the barbers' tool. It is a brittle but extremely sharp arma that is very easy to slip into a pocket or sleeve.

equipment->Necklace of Fireballs VI.description:
Este string of beads appears to be a hemp string with lustrous red beads of various sizes hanging from it. When activated, it briefly appears in its true form: a golden chain with golden spheres attached by fine threads.

Este necklace has one @Damage[16d6[fire]] daño, three @Damage[14d6[fire]] daño y four @Damage[12d6[fire]] daño beads with a Reflex save DC of 36. When all the beads are gone, the necklace becomes a non-magical hemp string.

Activar A Interactuar

Efecto Tu detach a sphere from the necklace, causing it to glow with orange light. After tu activate a sphere, if tu or anyone else hurls it (an Interactuar action with the ranged rasgo), it detonates as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{Fireball} where it lands. Tu toss can place the center of the fireball anywhere within 70 pies, though at the GM's discretion tu might need to make an tirada de ataque if the throw is unusually challenging. If no one hurls the sphere by el comienzo de tu siguiente turno, it turns into a non-magical red bead.

action->Bloody Mayhem.name: Bloody Mayhem
action->Bloody Mayhem.description: Sad Liza Strides three times. Once per Zancada, she can intentar una war razor Golpe against a criatura in her reach at any point during the Zancada; she must make each Golpe against a different criatura, but she doesn't apply her multiple attack penalizador until after making all her Golpes. If any of the Golpes are a critical failure, Bloody Mayhem immediately ends.

action->Close Cutter.name: Close Cutter
action->Close Cutter.description: Siempre que Sad Liza inflige daño cortante, el objetivo sufre an additional 2d10 daño persistente de sangrado.

action->Fan of Daggers.name: Fan of Daggers
action->Fan of Daggers.description: Sad Liza makes three ranged dagger Golpes, each against a separate target; she ignores the multiple attack penalizador until after making all three Golpes. Con un impacto critico, el objetivo sufre @Damage[2d10[bleed]] daño y is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} durante 1 asalto.

action->Knife Thrower.name: Knife Thrower
action->Knife Thrower.description: Sad Liza's ranged dagger Golpes have a range increment of 20 pies instead of 10 pies.

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.3Lexs7KnhbV0HgFh]

Este varita features a carved dragon's head at its top y a polished metal sphere set in its midsection.

Activar Lanzar un conjuro

Frecuencia Una vez al día, más sobrecarga

Efecto Lanzas @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} at 3rd rank.

After lanzas the conjuro, an additional missile or missiles are released from the varita at the start of each of tus turnos, as though lanzas the 1-action version of magic missile. Elige targets each time. Este lasts durante 1 minuto, until estas no longer wielding the wand, or until tu try to activate the varita again.

Requisitos de fabricación Supply a casting of magic missile of the appropriate rank.

action->Drain Wand.name: Drain Wand
action->Drain Wand.description:
Frecuencia una vez al dia

Requisitos Scathka hasn't acted yet on their turn

Efecto On their turn, Scathka casts one conjuro they've prepared y already cast this day without spending a conjuro slot. Scathka must still Lanzar el conjuro y meet the conjuro's other requirements.

action->Throw Shadow Blade.name: Throw Shadow Blade
action->Throw Shadow Blade.description:
Requisito Scathka is wielding a dagger

Efecto Scathka draws a shadowy glyph on the dagger's blade y flings it at a nearby foe. Scathka makes a ranged Golpe with the dagger with the range increment to 30 pies.

If the Golpe hits, it inflige @Damage[8d6[cold]] daño (double daño on a critical success) y el objetivo debe tener exito en una @Check[fortitude|dc:32] salvacion or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} until el final de su siguiente turno (or [[/br 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 asaltos} on a critical failure).

The dagger loses its shadowy magic as soon as the attack is resolved.

armor->Chain Shirt.description: Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail y protects only the torso, upper arms, y upper legs of its wearer.

equipment->Cape of the Mountebank.name: Cape of the Mountebank
equipment->Cape of the Mountebank.description:
Este bright red-and-gold cape is often interlaced with glittery threads y serves as a distraction. While wearing the cape, obtienes a +2 bonificador por objeto to DECEPTION checks.

Activar 2 Interactuar

Frecuencia una vez al dia

Efecto Lanzas @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate}. The space tu leave y the one tu appear in are filled with puffs of smoke that make anyone within concealed until they leave the smoke or the end of tu next turn, at which point the smoke dissipates. Strong winds immediately disperse the smoke.

equipment->Religious Symbol of Norgorber.name: Religious Symbol of Norgorber
equipment->Religious Symbol of Norgorber.description: Esta pieza de madera o plata está adornada con una imagen que representa un dios. Algunos lanzadores de conjuros divinos, como los clérigos, pueden utilizar un símbolo religioso de su dios como foco divino para utilizar ciertas habilidades y lanzar algunos conjuros. Se debe sostener un símbolo religioso en una mano para usarlo.

action->+1 Status to All Saves vs. Menta.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Mental

action->Designate Apostate.name: Designate Apostate
action->Designate Apostate.description: Velberi designates one criatura she can see a 30 pies o menos as an apostate to the church of Norgorber, regardless of the criatura's actual religious leanings. She can have up to four apostates designated at a time; any additional apostate removes another apostate of her choice. Velberi treats all Perception checks made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} against an apostate as one degree of success better, y her Golpes deal an additional 2d8 daño mental to apostates.

Shatterling.name: Fragmentario

action->Attack of Opportunity.name: Ataque de oportunidad
action->Attack of Opportunity.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura al alcance del monstruo usa una accion de manipular o una accion de movimiento, realiza un ataque a distancia o abandona una casilla durante una accion de movimiento que esta usando.

Efecto El monstruo intenta un Golpe cuerpo a cuerpo contra la criatura desencadenante. Si el ataque es un impacto critico y el desencadenante fue una accion de manipular, el monstruo interrumpe esa accion. Este Golpe no cuenta para el penalizador por ataques multiples del monstruo, y su penalizador por ataques multiples no se aplica a este Golpe.

action->Divert Strike.name: Divert Golpe
action->Divert Strike.description:
Desencadenante Una shatterling takes non-daño contundente y there's an unbroken mirror at least 1 pies wide a 100 pies o menos of the shatterling

Efecto El nearest mirror to the shatterling at least 1 pies wide breaks, y the daño to the shatterling is reduced to 0.

action->Extra Reaction.name: Extra Reaction
action->Extra Reaction.description: A shatterling gains an additional reaction each turn, but can use this extra reaction only for Divert Golpe.

action->Mirror Senses.name: Mirror Senses
action->Mirror Senses.description: A shatterling can see y hear through any unbroken mirror a 100 pies o menos.

action->Blood-Fueled Titter.name: Blood-Fueled Titter
action->Blood-Fueled Titter.description: If the shatterling attempts an INTIMIDATION check to [[/act demoralize]] a target a 30 pies o menos of a criatura with daño persistente de sangrado, the shatterling has +4 bonificador por circunstancia to the INTIMIDATION check. In addition, the shatterling takes no penalizador to the check for not speaking a language el objetivo can hear, y el objetivo isn't temporarily immune to the shatterling's attempts to DEMORALIZE it unless the shatterling critically fails its INTIMIDATION check.

action->Mirror Jump.name: Mirror Jump
action->Mirror Jump.description: During this Zancada, the shatterling can move into any unbroken mirror at least 1 pies wide y out of another unbroken mirror at least 1 pies wide a 100 pies o menos of the first mirror, treating the mirrors as connected. The shatterling can move through any number of pairs of pies-wide mirrors during its mirror jump, requiring each pair to be a 100 pies o menos of each other while doing so.

action->Vanish in Reflections.name: Vanish in Reflections
action->Vanish in Reflections.description: The shatterling doesn't appear in reflective surfaces if it doesn't want to. When it's a 100 pies o menos of an unbroken mirror at least 1 pies wide, a shatterling can Hide y Sneak even without cover or without being concealed.

action->Wipe Away Cracks.name: Wipe Away Cracks
action->Wipe Away Cracks.description: El shatterling touches un roto mirror, instantly repairing ello.

Shatterling.publicNotes: Estos constructos quebrados reaccionan con violencia ante el movimiento descuidado. Cuando una criatura a su alcance usa una acción de manipular o de movimiento, realiza un ataque a distancia o abandona una casilla durante una acción de movimiento, el fragmentario intenta un Golpe cuerpo a cuerpo contra la criatura desencadenante.

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ezVp13Uw8cWW08Da]

Aunque existen en una gran variedad de formas y tamanos, la proteccion que ofrecen los escudos de madera procede de la solidez de sus materiales. Aunque los escudos de madera son menos caros que los de acero, se rompen con mas facilidad.
