action->Deep Breath.name: Contener La Respiración
action->Deep Breath.description: Un Shikwashim mercenary puede contener la respiracion for 20 minutos.

action->Coordinated Distraction.name: Distracción coordinada
action->Coordinated Distraction.description:
With a sharp whistle or wave of their hand, the mercenary distracts an opponent so one of the mercenary's allies can ly a clean blow.

The mercenary chooses a target y an ally, both of whom must be a 30 pies o menos of the mercenary. El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} against the first Golpe the mercenary's ally makes on its next turn; if the ally doesn't Golpe that target, the effect is lost.

Depending on how the mercenary distracts their foe, this action gains either the auditory or visual rasgo.

action->Human Hunter.name: Human Hunter
action->Human Hunter.description: A Shikwashim mercenary's multiple attack penalizador for attacks against humans is -3 (-2 with an agile arma) on their second attack per turn or -6 (-4 with an agile arma) on their third or subsequent attack per turn.

action->Powerful Swipe.name: Powerful Swipe
action->Powerful Swipe.description:
The Shikwashim mercenary makes a melee Golpe. If it hits, it inflige an extra die of daño.

Este counts as two attacks for the mercenary's multiple attack penalizador.

action->Terrain Advantage.name: Ventaja De Terreno
action->Terrain Advantage.description: Non-lizardfolk criaturas in difficult terrain y non-lizardfolk criaturas that are in water y lack a Swim speed are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to a Shikwashim mercenary.

action->Compression.name: Compression
action->Compression.description: Cuando un shredskin successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeezes}, ello mueve through el tight espacio at full speed. Narrow confines son no terreno dificil for un shredskin.

action->Constrict.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.g26YiEIfSHCpLocV]

@Damage[(1d4+4)[contundente]] daño, @Check[fortitude|dc:16|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Constrict]

action->Control Body.name: Control Body
action->Control Body.description:
Requisitos El shredskin is adjacent to a Medium or Small humanoid-shaped corpse

Efecto El shredskin wraps itself around the corpse y takes control of the host body. While controlling a host, the shredskin uses the host's Velocidad but its own attacks, y it loses its GRAB y Enshroud abilities.

Attacks that target the shredskin while it controls a body deal half of the daño to the shredskin y half of the daño to the host body. Attacks that target an area deal daño to both the shredskin y host body normally.

The shredskin can release the host body as a free action at the start of its turn. If the host is destroyed, the shredskin automatically releases the body y is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} durante 1 asalto. A Medium corpse typically has 15 hit points, while a Small corpse typically has 10 Puntos de Golpe.

Las criaturas can notice that a corpse is controlled by a shredskin by succeeding a Perception check against the shredskin's DECEPTION DC.

action->Enshroud.name: Enshroud
action->Enshroud.description:
Requisitos El shredskin is grabbing a criatura

Efecto El shredskin attempts to pin the criatura y wrap itself around the criatura like a shirt. The shredskin rolls an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the criatura's Fortitude DC.

Con un exito, the criatura becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Neutralizado} y the shredskin can take control of the criatura as if using Control Body.

At the start of its turn, the shredskin can automatically Constrict the enshrouded criatura as a free action.

An enshrouded criatura can intentar una DC 16 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} check to break free (DC 18 if the shredskin critically succeeded its ATHLETICS check to Enshroud).

treasure->Victor's Medallion from the Ch.name: Victor's Medallion from the Challenge of Sky y Heaven

action->Flurry of Blows.name: Ráfaga De Golpes
action->Flurry of Blows.description:
Shristi makes two unarmed Golpes. If both hit the same criatura, combine their daño for the purposes of resistances y weaknesses. He applies his multiple attack penalizador to the Golpes normally.

As it has the flourish rasgo, Shristi can use Flurry of Blows only once per turn.

action->Heaven's Thunder.name: Trueno del cielo
action->Heaven's Thunder.description:
Frecuencia twice per day

Efecto With a loud shout, Shristi unleashes his ki as a crackling shroud of thunder y lightning that engulfs his body. Until the end of his next turn, Shristi's unarmed Golpes y Golpes with armas that have the monk rasgo deal an additional 3 daño de electricidad y 3 daño sónico.

action->Sky and Heaven Stance.name: Postura del cielo y el cielo
action->Sky and Heaven Stance.description:
Shristi enters a combat stance perfected by past champions of the Challenge of Sky y Heaven. While in this stance, the only Golpes Shristi can make are skyward slash ataques sin armas. Estos deal 1d10 daño cortante; are in the brawling group; y have the nonlethal, unarmed, y versatile P rasgos.

While in Sky y Heaven Stance, Shristi gains resistance 2 to electricity y daño sónico.

spell->Meld into Stone (At Will).name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vh1RpbWfqdNC4L3P]
Fundirse con la piedra (a voluntad)

spell->Mage Hand.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.pwzdSlJgYqN7bs2w]
Mage Hand

action->Exorcism.name: Exorcism
action->Exorcism.description:
Mental daño ignores a siege shard's hardness.

Additionally, proving the siege shard's generative conflict is over with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ma93dpT4K7JbP9gu]{Prove Peace} activity reverts the criatura to ordinary stone.

action->Surreptitious Siege.name: Surreptitious Siege
action->Surreptitious Siege.description: While a siege shard is embedded within a structure while using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vh1RpbWfqdNC4L3P]{One with Stone}, the structure y all objects within it take twice as long to REPAIR.

action->Overwhelming Anguish.name: Overwhelming Anguish
action->Overwhelming Anguish.description:
Frecuencia una vez por minuto

Efecto El siege shard emits a disorienting psychic blast. All criaturas within a @Template[emanation|distance:15] take @Damage[4d6[mental]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[will|dc:20|basic|options:area-effect] salvacion).

action->Rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenecimiento
action->Rejuvenation.description:
When a siege shard is destroyed a 100 pies o menos of a structure, it reforms after [[/br 2d4 #days]] days within the nearest structure, fully healed.

A siege shard within a structure can permanently destroyed by the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.QW2gYIKce3W31xXf]{Prove Peace} activity.

action->Distracting Shadows.name: Sombras distractoras
action->Distracting Shadows.description: Skebs can use criaturas that are at least one size larger than themself as cover for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} actions.

action->Sneak Attack.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.AWvNPE4U0kEJSL1T]

Skebs inflige 1d6 daño adicional de precisión to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} criaturas.

weapon->+1 Shortsword.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.7tKkkF8eZ4iCLJtp]
+1 Shortsword

weapon->War Razor.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.nOFcCidD5AwVZWTv]

A war razor is an exaggerated version of the barbers' tool. It is a brittle but extremely sharp arma that is very easy to slip into a pocket or sleeve.

equipment->Religious Symbol (Silver) of.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.upzjwQ96cZG0Xlmx]
Religious Symbol (Silver) of Norgorber
equipment->Religious Symbol (Silver) of.description:
La etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.upzjwQ96cZG0Xlmx]

Esta pieza de madera o plata está adornada con una imagen que representa un dios. Algunos lanzadores de conjuros divinos, como los clérigos, pueden utilizar un símbolo religioso de su dios como foco divino para utilizar ciertas habilidades y lanzar algunos conjuros. Se debe sostener un símbolo religioso en una mano para usarlo.

equipment->Skinsaw Mask.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.sgH9U2fKqWCedKNO]

A patchwork of humanoid flesh makes up this grotesque mask stitched together with black silk or wire. It is distinctive for its bulbous orange eye- crafted from a magical glass bauble-y wide row of teeth.

When worn, the mask amplifies tu ability to sense fear in other criaturas.

Tu automatically know the value of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado} condicion of any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.1wQY3JYyhMYeeV2G]{Observado} criatura, y obtienes a +1 bonificador por objeto to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} asustado criaturas. Siempre que tu deal daño de precision to a asustado criatura, tu deal 1 daño adicional de precisión.

If estas not evil, estas @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 2} while wearing the Skinsaw mask.

action->Sneak Attack.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.AWvNPE4U0kEJSL1T]

When attacking an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} criatura, the Skinsaw murderer inflige 1d6 daño adicional de precisión.

action->Twin Takedown.name: Derribo gemelo
action->Twin Takedown.description:
Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Requisito Estas wielding two melee armas, each in a different hand.

Efecto Tu swiftly attack tu hunted prey with both armas. Make two Golpes against a criatura, one with each of the required armas. If both hit the same criatura, combine their daño for the purpose of its resistances y weaknesses. Apply tu multiple attack penalizador to each Golpe normally.

weapon->+1 Striking Shortsword.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.7tKkkF8eZ4iCLJtp]
+1 Striking Shortsword

weapon->War Razor.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.nOFcCidD5AwVZWTv]

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.sgH9U2fKqWCedKNO]

A patchwork of humanoid flesh makes up this grotesque mask stitched together with black silk or wire. It is distinctive for its bulbous orange eye- crafted from a magical glass bauble-y wide row of teeth.

When worn, the mask amplifies tu ability to sense fear in other criaturas.

Tu automatically know the value of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado} condicion of any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.1wQY3JYyhMYeeV2G]{Observado} criatura, y obtienes a +1 bonificador por objeto to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} asustado criaturas. Siempre que tu deal daño de precision to a asustado criatura, tu deal 1 daño adicional de precisión.

If estas not evil, estas @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 2} while wearing the Skinsaw mask.

action->Wire Catch.name: Wire Catch
action->Wire Catch.description:
Every Skinsaw seamer keeps a sewing needle attached to a loop of thick silk, wrapped loosely around their mano not holding a arma, which they can use in combat to snag or disarm attackers

Desencadenante Una criatura hits the seamer with a melee Golpe

Efecto El seamer attempts an ATHLETICS check to either [[/act grapple]] or [[/act disarm]] the triggering criatura.

action->Flay.name: Flay
action->Flay.description:
Requisitos El Skinsaw seamer dealt daño with a melee arma other than its war razor with their last action

Efecto El seamer makes a war razor Golpe against the same criatura that they just damaged. Con un impacto, the seamer slices a strip of flesh from el objetivo y inflige @Damage[1d6[bleed]] in addition to the war razor's usual daño.

action->Quick Stitch.name: Quick Stitch
action->Quick Stitch.description:
Requisitos El Skinsaw seamer is currently grappling a criatura

Efecto El seamer stitches a piece of cloth to the criatura's arm, face, or leg, potentially hindering it. The criatura debe intentar una @Check[reflex|dc:26|traits:damaging-effect] tirada de salvacion; if the seamer has already successfully used their Flay ability against the criatura within the past minute, the criatura's save result is one degree of success worse.

Éxito critico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura takes @Damage[1d4[perforante]] daño.

Fallo The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Deslumbrado}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} (seamer's choice). Este effect lasts until the criatura spends a single action to tear out the stitching, which inflige @Damage[1d6[perforante]] daño to it.

Fallo critico The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 2}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 2}, or desprevenido (seamer's choice). Este effect lasts until the criatura spends 2 actions to tear out the stitching, which inflige @Damage[2d6[perforante]] daño to it.

action->Pest Haven.name: Pest Haven
action->Pest Haven.description:
The rotting hides y molding straw stuffing of skitterstitches are ideal nesting grounds for vermin y insect swarms. Any animal swarm sharing a space with a skitterstitch gains curacion rapida 3.

Additionally, if a criatura inflige at least 10 perforante or daño cortante to the skitterstitchstitch, the swarm can use its swarming bites Golpe (or similar attack) against the attacker as a reaction.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.CM14G9kLI97aIC5h]{Efecto: Pest Haven}

action->Spider Swarm Host.name: Spider Swarm Host
action->Spider Swarm Host.description: Skitterstitches host un @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.NcYbJS5PWBGdNDqh]{Spider Swarm} dentro de themselves, que erupts out cuando el Skitterstitch es destruido

action->Flay.name: Flay
action->Flay.description: The skitterstitch makes a blade Golpe against an animal or humanoid. Con un exito, the skitterstitch slices a long strip of flesh from el objetivo; if the skitterstitch dealt daño, it inflige an additional 1d6 daño persistente de sangrado.

action->Skitterstitch Venom.name: Skitterstitch Venom
action->Skitterstitch Venom.description:
Tirada de salvacion @Check[fortitude|dc:23|traits:poison]

Duración máxima 6 asaltos

Etapa 1 @Damage[1d10[poison]] daño, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido}, y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 1} (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 @Damage[1d10[poison]] daño, desprevenido, y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 2} (1 asalto)

action->Stitch Skin.name: Stitch Skin
action->Stitch Skin.description:
Requisitos El skitterstitch hasn't used this ability since the last time it successfully used its Flay ability

Efecto El skitterstitch sews flayed flesh to its body to seal tears y rents. The skitterstitch regains @Damage[8[healing]] Puntos de Golpe.

weapon->+1 Striking Temple Sword.name: +1 Striking Temple Sword
weapon->+1 Striking Temple Sword.description: Este heavy blade is favored by guardians of religious sites. It has a distinctive, crescent-shaped blade that seems to be a mix of a sickle y sword. It often has holes drilled into the blade or the pommel so that bells or other holy trinkets can be affixed to the arma as an aid for prayer or mediation.

shield->Steel Shield.description:
Like wooden shields, steel shields come in a variety of shapes y sizes. Though more expensive than wooden shields, they are much more durable.

Hardness HP BT
5 20 10

ammo->Arrows.name: Flechas
ammo->Arrows.description: Estos projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end y bears a metal head on the other.

action->Attack of Opportunity.name: Ataque de oportunidad
action->Attack of Opportunity.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura al alcance del monstruo usa una accion de manipular o una accion de movimiento, realiza un ataque a distancia o abandona una casilla durante una accion de movimiento que esta usando.

Efecto El monstruo intenta un Golpe cuerpo a cuerpo contra la criatura desencadenante. Si el ataque es un impacto critico y el desencadenante fue una accion de manipular, el monstruo interrumpe esa accion. Este Golpe no cuenta para el penalizador por ataques multiples del monstruo, y su penalizador por ataques multiples no se aplica a este Golpe.

action->Wary.name: Wary
action->Wary.description: The veteran isn't desprevenido to hidden criaturas y always gains a +4 bonificador por circunstancia to their Perception DC against criaturas attempting to Create a Diversion or Lie to the veteran.

action->Power Attack.name: Ataque Poderoso
action->Power Attack.description: The veteran makes a melee Golpe that counts as two attacks when calculating their multiple attack penalizador. If this strike hits, it inflige an extra die of daño del arma.

action->Swipe.name: Barrido
action->Swipe.description: The veteran makes a melee Golpe y compares the tirada de ataque result to the AC of up to two foes, each of whom must be within their melee reach y adjacent to each other. Roll daño only once y apply it to each criatura hit. A Swipe counts as two attacks for the veteran's multiple attack penalizador.

Slithering Rift.name: Fisura reptante

action->Tremorsense (Imprecise) 120 feet.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.j2wsK6IsW5yMW1jW]
Tremorsense (Imprecise) 120 pies

action->Transparent.name: Transparent
action->Transparent.description:
A slithering rift is so clear that it's difficult to spot. A successful @Check[perception|dc:48] check is required to notice a stationary slithering rift, y a criatura must be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Searching} to attempt this check.

A criatura that walks into the rift's space might fall into any pit currently in effect due to Dimensional Pit.

action->Breach Vulnerability.name: Breach Vulnerability
action->Breach Vulnerability.description:
Ingesting an extradimensional space like that found in a bag of holding inflige @Damage[12d8[force]] daño to the slithering rift y its occupants.

The slithering rift then immediately uses Out Tu Go.

action->Dimensional Pit.name: Dimensional Pit
action->Dimensional Pit.description:
The slithering rift opens an extradimensional, 20-pies-deep pit that covers its own space y all adjacent squares unless they are walls or similarly blocking terrain.

Any other criatura occupying spaces in the pit debe tener exito en una @Check[reflex|dc:40|traits:damaging-effect] salvacion or fall into the pit, taking daño from the fall (typically @Damage[10[contundente]] daño). Any criatura grabbed by the ooze is released from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.i18TlebMzwONyPhI]{GRAB} y falls in, even if it was outside the pit squares.

While the pit is open, the slithering rift is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizado} y can't be forced to move. It can make pseudopod Golpes originating from the walls of the pit. A criatura that starts its turn at the bottom of the pit takes @Damage[5d6[acid]] daño.

Las criaturas can CLIMB the walls with a @Check[athletics|dc:40|name:Climb Out of the Rift|traits:action:climb] check. When the slithering rift dies, the pit closes y criaturas inside are ejected, as Out tu Go.

action->Flurry of Pods.name: Flurry of Pods
action->Flurry of Pods.description:
The slithering rift makes a single pseudopod Golpe against each target within range it hasn't already @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado}.

Estos attacks count toward the slithering rift's multiple attack penalizador, but this penalizador doesn't increase until after all of these attacks.

action->Out You Go.name: Out Tu Go
action->Out You Go.description:
The slithering rift closes all pit spaces it created using Dimensional Pit, ejecting all its occupants onto the ground into random free spaces where the opening of the pit was.

Each occupant takes @Damage[9d6[contundente]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:40|basic] salvacion).

Slithering Rift.publicNotes: Una fisura reptante es tan transparente que resulta difícil de detectar. Se requiere una prueba con éxito para advertir una fisura reptante inmóvil, y una criatura debe estar buscando activamente para intentar esta prueba. Una criatura que camina dentro del espacio de la fisura puede caer en cualquier destino imposible que ésta conecte.

weapon->Thunderstone (Greater).name: Thunderstone (Greater)
weapon->Thunderstone (Greater).description:
When this stone hits a criatura or a hard surface, it explodes with a deafening bang. A thunderstone inflige the listed daño sónico y daño de salpicadura de sónico, y each criatura within 10 pies of the space in which the stone exploded debe tener exito en una Fortitude tirada de salvacion with the listed DC or be deafened until el final de su siguiente turno. Many types of thunderstone grant an bonificador por objeto a las tiradas de ataque.

Obtienes +2 bonificador por objeto a las tiradas de ataque. La bomba causa 3d4 daño sónico y 3 daño de salpicadura de sónico, y the DC is 28.

weapon->+1 Striking Longsword.name: +1 Striking Longsword
weapon->+1 Striking Longsword.description: Las espadas largas pueden tener uno o dos filos. Sus hojas son pesadas y miden entre 3 y 4 pies de longitud.

armor->Chain Shirt.description: Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail y protects only the torso, upper arms, y upper legs of its wearer.

ammo->Bolts.name: Virotes
ammo->Bolts.description: Mas cortos que las flechas tradicionales pero de construccion similar, los virotes son la municion que usan las ballestas.

action->Binding Blast.name: Binding Blast
action->Binding Blast.description: A commando's thunderstone is infused with special reagents to produce a blinding flash of light. In addition to the thunderstone's normal effects, criaturas that fail the tirada de salvacion against the thunderstone are also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Deslumbrado} durante 1 asalto. Las criaturas that critically fail are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} durante 1 asalto. Las criaturas who protect their eyes, such as by wearing tinted goggles, are immune to the infused thunderstone's blinding effect.

action->Target Culprit.name: Target Culprit
action->Target Culprit.description: The commando designates a single criatura as their culprit. The commando gains a +2 bonificador por circunstancia to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} their culprit y a +2 bonificador por circunstancia to SURVIVAL checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} their culprit. The commando's attacks deal an additional 2d8 daño de precision to the culprit. Este designation lasts durante 24 horas or until the commando targets another criatura with this ability.

Summoning Rune (Barbazu Devil).name: Summoning Rune (Barbazu Devil)
Summoning Rune (Barbazu Devil).description: A summoning circle inlaid into the room's floor detects criatura vivas y summons a violent devil.
Summoning Rune (Barbazu Devil).disable: @Check[perception|dc:18|name:Notice the Trap's Magic|traits:action:seek] to notice the trap's magic y avoid stepping on the floor outside the circle, followed by @Check[thievery|dc:21|name:Break Summoning Circle|traits:action:disable-a-device] (entrenado) to break the circle or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (3rd rank; counteract DC 23) to counteract the rune
Summoning Rune (Barbazu Devil).reset: La trampa resets each day at dawn.

action->Summon Devil.name: Summon Devil
action->Summon Devil.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura viva steps on any part of the floor not enclosed by the summoning circle

Efecto One round after a criatura touches the triggering area, the door to the room slams shut y locks (two [[/act pick-a-lock dc=20]]{THIEVERY} checks to pick) y a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.FIoRPHaHdYUPVKdT]{Barbazu} devil appears in the summoning circle.

The devil rolls initiative y remains for [[/br 3d6 #rounds]]{3d6 rounds}, after which the conjuro ends y the devil disappears. The devil also disappears if someone disables the trap before the duration expires.

The summoned devil can use 3 actions each round y can use reactions, unlike most summoned criaturas.

Summoning Rune (Cinder Rat).name: Summoning Rune (Cinder Rat)
Summoning Rune (Cinder Rat).description: An invisible cloud of magical sensors detects criatura vivas in the room y summons fire elementals to slay the criaturas.
Summoning Rune (Cinder Rat).disable: @Check[acrobatics|dc:22|name:Approach Rune] (entrenado) to approach without triggering the trap, followed by @Check[thievery|dc:22|name:Erase Summoning Rune|traits:action:disable-a-device] (entrenado) to erase the rune or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (3rd rank; counteract DC 20) to counteract the rune
Summoning Rune (Cinder Rat).reset: La trampa resets each day at dawn.

action->Summon Elementals.name: Summon Elementals
action->Summon Elementals.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura viva enters the room

Efecto Two rounds after a criatura enters the room, the room's door slams shut y locks (two [[/act pick-a-lock dc=20]]{THIEVERY} checks to pick), y two @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.xN5J9S485LxFZMkL]{Cinder Rat} fire elementals emerge from the floor.

The elementals roll initiative y remain for [[/gmr 3d6 #rounds]]{3d6 rounds}, after which the conjuro ends y the criaturas disappear. The elementals also disappear if someone disables the trap before the duration expires.

The summoned elementals can use 3 actions each round y can use reactions, unlike most summoned criaturas.

Supplicant Statues.name: Supplicant Statues
Supplicant Statues.description: Six statues rapidly slide around el sala en rollers, slowing down intruders y striking at them con spring-loaded sword arms.
Supplicant Statues.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:34|name:Disable Statue Rollers|traits:action:disable-a-device] (maestro) to disable a specific statue's rollers, or @Check[thievery|dc:39|name:Disable Trap (Control Panel)|traits:action:disable-a-device] (maestro) on the control panel in A4 deactivates the whole trap. For each statue disabled, the trap loses 1 action from its routine y the DC for its predictive impediment ability decreases by 4. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (7th rank, counteract DC 32) doesn't harm the statues but removes the predictive impediment ability. Breaking the control panel prevents the trap from resetting.
Supplicant Statues.reset: La trampa deactivates y resets one minute after the room is empty.
Supplicant Statues.routine: (6 actions) On the trap's initiative, each functioning statue slides up to 40 pies around the room y makes a statue shortsword Golpe against an adjacent criatura. La trampa doesn't take a multiple attack penalizador, y the statues' movements don't trigger reactions.

action->Animated Statues.name: Animated Statues
action->Animated Statues.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura enters a square adjacent to a statue

Efecto La trampa makes a statue shortsword Golpe against the triggering criatura, activates its predictive impediment ability, y then rolls initiative.

action->Predictive Impediment.name: Predictive Impediment
action->Predictive Impediment.description: The statues continually slide around to bump into criaturas y block their passage through the room. The first time on its turn that a criatura attempts to move within the room, it debe tener exito en una @Check[reflex|dc:36] salvacion or treat the entire room as difficult terrain durante 1 asalto. Con un fallo critico, the criatura is also knocked prone.

spell->Chill Touch.name:

spell->Produce Flame.name: Produce Flame
spell->Produce Flame.description:
A small ball of flame appears in the palm of tu mano, y tu lash out with it either in melee or at range. Make a conjuro tirada de ataque against tu target's AC. Este is normally a ranged attack, but puedes also make a melee attack against a criatura in tu unarmed reach.

Con un exito, tu deal 2d4 daño de fuego. Con un exito critico, el objetivo sufre double daño y @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,fire]] daño.

Heightened (+1) Increase the daño by 1d4 y the daño persistente on a impacto critico by 1d4.

Etapa 3 @Damage[2d6[poison]] daño y stupefied 2 (1 asalto)

action->Shadow Step.name: Shadow Dar un paso
action->Shadow Step.description:
The svartalfar killer fades into shadow, Strides up to twice its Velocidad, y reforms.

Este movement no desencadena reacciones, but the svartalfar killer must begin y end in an area of dim light or darkness.

action->Sneak Attack.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.AWvNPE4U0kEJSL1T]

A svartalfar killer inflige an extra 2d6 daño de precision to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} criaturas.

action->Spell-Imbued Blade.name: Spell-Imbued Blade
action->Spell-Imbued Blade.description:
The svartalfar killer chooses @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gISYsBFby1TiXfBt]{Acid Splash}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6DfLZBl8wKIV03Iq]{Ignition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.J7Y7tl0bbdz7TcCc]{Enfeeble}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r3NeUnsgt9mS03Sn]{Shocking Grasp} y makes a melee Golpe.

If the svartalfar killer hits, they cast the chosen conjuro through the arma at the same target. The conjuro's tirada de ataque is the same result as the Golpe.

action->Obscuring Grab.name: Obscuring Grab
action->Obscuring Grab.description: While the tenome is Grabbing a criatura, all other criaturas are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} to the tenome.

action->Bone Drink.name: Bone Drink
action->Bone Drink.description:
Requisito The tenome has a criatura grabbed or restrained

Efecto El tenome makes a jaws Golpe against the grabbed or restrained criatura. If the Golpe hits, the criatura debe tener exito en una @Check[fortitude|dc:18] salvacion or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 1} (or the value of the criatura's drained condicion increases by 1 if it already has a drained value, to a maximum of drained 4).

The tenome regains [[/r 1d8[healing]]] Puntos de Golpe each time it uses Bone Drink.

action->Burst of Velocidad.name: Burst of Velocidad
action->Burst of Velocidad.description:
The tenome Strides twice, Steps twice, or Steps y Strides (in either order).

It cannot use Burst of Velocidad again for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Terrifying Gaze.name: Terrifying Gaze
action->Terrifying Gaze.description:
1 or 2 actions

A tenome can gaze at a criatura a 30 pies o menos by presenting one of its eyes. El objetivo debe tener exito en una @Check[will|dc:21] salvacion or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}. If the tenome uses 2 actions y presents both of its eyes, el objetivo is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado} if it fails the save.

A criatura that successfully saves is temporarily immune durante 24 horas.

action->Emotion Sense 120 feet.name: Emotion Sense 120 pies
action->Emotion Sense 120 feet.description: A teraphant can sense the emotions of criaturas a 120 pies o menos as an imprecise sense. Emotion sense is a precise sense against criaturas under an emotion effect. A criatura under the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b515AZlB0sridKSq]{Calm} can't be noticed via emotion sense.

action->Empathetic Response.name: Empathetic Response
action->Empathetic Response.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura within 60 pies of the teraphant is targeted by a conjuro or ability with the emotion rasgo

Efecto El teraphant also benefits from the conjuro or effect, as though it were an additional target durante 1 minuto or until the triggering conjuro or ability ends.

action->Impale.name: Impale
action->Impale.description:
Requisito The teraphant has a criatura grabbed

Efecto El teraphant slams the criatura onto one of its horns. El objetivo debe intentar una @Check[reflex|dc:27|basic] salvacion or suffer @Damage[(3d6+9)[perforante]] daño y @Damage[1d6[bleed]] (@Damage[(6d6+18)[perforante]] daño on a critical failure).

action->Psychokinetic Trumpet.name: Psychokinetic Trumpet
action->Psychokinetic Trumpet.description:
The teraphant lets out a loud trumpet that inflige @Damage[8d8[mental]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[will|dc:27|basic|options:area-effect,forced-movement] salvacion) in a @Template[cone|distance:30]. A criatura that fails its save is also pushed 15 pies (30 pies on a critical failure).

If a pushed criaturas strikes a solid barrier, it takes @Damage[3d6[contundente]] daño y stops.

The teraphant can't use Psychokinetic Trumpet again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Psychokinetic Trumpet]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Trample.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.UNah0bxXxkcZjxO3]

Large or smaller, pies, @Check[reflex|dc:27|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Trample]

action->Grabbing Trunk.name: Grabbing Trunk
action->Grabbing Trunk.description: A Medium or smaller criatura hit by the teraphant's trunk is grabbed. If the teraphant moves, it can bring the grabbed criatura along with it.

The Inkmaster.name: El Maestro de la Tinta
The Inkmaster.publicNotes: Los shemhazian surgen de las almas de torturadores y de quienes se recreaban mutilando los cuerpos físicos de sus víctimas. Con 35 pies de altura, un shemhazian está bien equipado con una amplia variedad de garras, zarpas y colmillos para seguir infligiendo dolor. El Maestro de la Tinta canaliza esa brutalidad a través de marcas, cortes y símbolos que convierten la carne en un registro de sufrimiento.
The Inkmaster.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

action->Clockwork Brain.name: Clockwork Brain
action->Clockwork Brain.description: Un second brain, made de clockwork, es implanted en el Inkmaster's skull. Any time el makes un salvacion de Voluntad, el rolls twice y recibe el higher result.

action->Paralyzing Gaze.name: Paralyzing Gaze
action->Paralyzing Gaze.description: 30 pies. A non-evil criatura that ends its turn in the aura debe intentar una @Check[fortitude|dc:35|options:area-effect,inflicts:ralentizado,inflicts:paralyzed] salvacion. If it fails, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} durante 1 asalto, y if it critically fails, it is instead @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} durante 1 asalto.

action->Succor Vulnerability.name: Succor Vulnerability
action->Succor Vulnerability.description: A shemhazian's mutilation is a part of them, y they can't bear to see it reversed. The first time each round that a criatura heals from daño the shemhazian dealt on their last turn, the demon takes @Damage[3d6[mental]] daño.

action->Tail Whip.name: Tail Whip
action->Tail Whip.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura within reach of the shemhazian's tail leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Efecto El shemhazian attempts to [[/act trip]] the triggering criatura. Con un exito, the criatura also sufre daño as if the shemhazian had hit with a tail Golpe, y if the criatura was flying, it falls 30 pies.

action->Enfeebling Bite.name: Enfeebling Bite
action->Enfeebling Bite.description: If the shemhazian's jaws Golpe damages a criatura, el objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 3}. El objetivo can intentar una @Check[fortitude|dc:37] salvacion to reduce this to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1} (or be unaffected on a critical success).

action->Focused Gaze.name: Focused Gaze
action->Focused Gaze.description: The shemhazian focuses their gaze on a non-evil criatura they can see a 30 pies o menos. If that criatura isn't already ralentizado by the shemhazian's paralyzing gaze, it debe intentar una save against the shemhazian's paralyzing gaze. If that criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado}, it debe tener exito en una @Check[fortitude|dc:35] salvacion or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado} durante 1 asalto. A shemhazian can't use this ability against the same criatura more than una vez por asalto.

action->Improved Grab.name: Agarrón mejorado
action->Improved Grab.description:
Requisitos El monster's last action was a success with a Golpe that lists Improved GRAB in its daño entry, or it has a criatura grabbed using this action.

Efecto El monster automatically Grabs el objetivo hasta el final de the monster's next turn. The criatura is grabbed by whichever body part the monster attacked with, y that body part can't be used to Golpe criaturas until the GRAB is ended. Using Improved GRAB extends the duration of the monster's Improved GRAB until el final de su siguiente turno for all criaturas grabbed by it, but this costs an action. A grabbed criatura can use the Escape action to get out of the GRAB, y the GRAB ends for a grabbed criaturas if the monster moves away from it.

The Laughing Fiend's Greeting.name: The Laughing Fiend's Greeting
The Laughing Fiend's Greeting.description: Subtle but deadly magical runes link this mural to Kharnas's maestro. Good- or neutral-aligned criaturas who examine the mural witness the castle's drawbridge silently descend, revealing an endless darkness.
The Laughing Fiend's Greeting.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:44|name:Disable Thievery] (legendario) to obscure or mar the magical runes set into the mural, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (9th rank; counteract DC 42) to counteract the mural

action->Tegresin's Greeting.name: Tegresin's Greeting
action->Tegresin's Greeting.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura capable of casting divine magic examines the mural

Efecto El mural casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qDjeG6dxT4aEEC6J]{Weird} (@Check[will|dc:43|traits:death,emotion,fear,illusion,mental,damaging-effect] salvacion) on all criaturas in the gallery. A snarl fills the criaturas' minds.

Este +2 greater striking dancing shortsword has a golden handguard resembling a bird with outstretched wings. The sword's blade is broken halfway up its length, but this doesn't impair the sword's function.

Tu do not need to have a mano free if estas wielding the blade of the Rabbit Prince, y tu target can be up to two sizes larger than tu.

Requisitos de fabricación Debes craft the blade in the Harrowed Realm.

action->Halfling Luck.description:
Frecuencia una vez al dia

Desencadenante El Rabbit Prince fails a prueba de habilidad or a tirada de salvacion

Efecto El Rabbit Prince rerolls the triggering check, but he must use the new result, even if it's worse.

action->Perfect Will.name: Voluntad perfecta
action->Perfect Will.description: Si el Rabbit Prince rolls un success en un salvacion de Voluntad, el gets un exito critico en su lugar, y si el rolls un critical failure, el gets un failure instead.

action->Superior Senses.name: Superior Senses
action->Superior Senses.description: The Rabbit Prince automatically critically succeeds at Seek actions to find hidden or undetected criaturas a 30 pies o menos y at flat checks to target criaturas a 30 pies o menos that are concealed or hidden from him.

action->Bloody Jab.name: Bloody Jab
action->Bloody Jab.description: Siempre que the Rabbit Prince inflige daño perforante, he also inflige 2d10 daño persistente de sangrado.

action->Darting Flurry.name: Darting Flurry
action->Darting Flurry.description: The Rabbit Prince Strides y makes a blade of the Rabbit Prince Golpe y a harrow card Golpe at any point during the Zancada. His multiple attack penalizador increases only after both attacks.

action->Quick Movements.name: Quick Movements
action->Quick Movements.description: The Rabbit Prince no desencadena reacciones with his movement or with any use of the THIEVERY skill.

action->True Appearance.name: True Appearance
action->True Appearance.description:
Desencadenante El Stabbing Beast is transformed with Change Shape y rolls for initiative

Efecto El Stabbing Beast ends Change Shape.

action->Blinding Stream.name: Blinding Stream
action->Blinding Stream.description: A criatura hit by the Stabbing Beast's venom stream debe tener exito en una @Check[fortitude|dc:33] salvacion or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} for [[/br 1d4 #Blinded Duration]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Change Shape.name: Cambiar de forma
action->Change Shape.description: The Stabbing Beast takes on the appearance of a Medium humanoid with a scorpion's tail y chitinous, full-body plate armor. Este doesn't change their Velocidad or Golpes, except that their reach becomes 5 pies y they can't make pincer Golpes.

action->Conjure Swords.name: Conjure Swords
action->Conjure Swords.description:
Requisitos El Stabbing Beast is using Change Shape

Efecto El Stabbing Beast summons one or two +2 greater striking keen shortswords into their hands. Estos armas disappear if they leave the Stabbing Beast's grasp or if the Stabbing Beast ends Change Shape.

action->Stabbing Beast Venom.name: Stabbing Beast Venom
action->Stabbing Beast Venom.description:
While a criatura is debilitado from this poison, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Condenado 1}

Tirada de salvacion @Check[fortitude|dc:36]

Duración máxima 6 asaltos

Etapa 1 @Damage[3d6[poison]] daño y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 2} (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 @Damage[4d6[poison]] daño y debilitado 2 (1 asalto)

Etapa 3 @Damage[6d6[poison]] daño y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 3} (1 asalto)

The Winder.name: The Winder
The Winder.description: A large metallic arm, 20 pies long, is set into the floor. It rotates around the room to wind up nearby clockwork criaturas.
The Winder.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:50|name:Deactivate System|traits:action:disable-a-device] (maestro) to deactivate the system, or @Check[athletics|dc:40|name:Jam Gears] (legendario) to jam the gears durante 1 asalto
The Winder.reset: The Winder resets as soon as no criaturas remain in the room.
The Winder.routine: (1, 2, o 4 actions, depending en el encounter's threat level) El Winder usa cada de su actions a Wind clockwork assassins en el sala, starting con inactive ones.

action->Wind Up.name: Wind Up
action->Wind Up.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura other than the Rumormonger enters the room, or the Rumormonger commands the device to activate

Efecto El Winder rolls initiative.

action->Wind.name: Wind
action->Wind.description: The Winder winds a clockwork criatura in the room. If the criatura is currently inactive, this activates the criatura, allowing it to act normally for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 asaltos}. If already active, this instead increases the number of rounds the clockwork criatura remains active by 1d4.

Tiderunner Aquamancer.name: Tiderunner Aquamancer
Tiderunner Aquamancer.saveDetails: +1 status a todos saves vs. enchantments, -2 a todos saves vs. aboleth effects

spell->Light.target: 1 objeto de Volumen 1 o menos, desatendido o en posesion tuya o de un aliado voluntario

Armadura de mago

action->Water Shield.name: Water Shield
action->Water Shield.description: The aquamancer is surrounded by a bubble of water that buffers attacks. Each round, the shield absorbs the first 25 daño that would be dealt to the aquamancer. The shield can absorb only contundente, perforante, cortante, acid, cold, y daño de fuego types. The aquamancer can dismiss or raise their shield by spending a single action.

weapon->+2 Greater Striking War Razor.name: +2 Greater Striking War Razor
weapon->+2 Greater Striking War Razor.description: A war razor is an exaggerated version of the barbers' tool. It is a brittle but extremely sharp arma that is very easy to slip into a pocket or sleeve.

action->Bloody Mayhem.name: Bloody Mayhem
action->Bloody Mayhem.description: Twisted Jack Strides three times. action->Spell Circle.name: Spell Circle
action->Spell Circle.description: By performing an hour-long ritual, an elemental vessel can form a conjuro circle with an arcane or primal spellcaster. After the conjuro circle is formed, other spellcasters can join the conjuro circle by performing the same hour-long ritual while assisted by at least one spellcaster already in the conjuro circle. Each member of the conjuro circle must contribute at least one conjuro to the elemental vessel. The spellcaster permanently loses access to a conjuro slot equal to the conjuro's rank y the elemental vessel adds the contributed conjuro to its list of arcane innate conjuros (regardless of the conjuro's original type). An elemental vessel can be imbued with no more than three conjuros per conjuro rank. If the elemental vessel is destroyed, all members of the conjuro circle regain the conjuro slots they contributed to the criatura. The arcane innate conjuros shown below represent a typical conjuro list for an elemental vessel, but each elemental vessel is likely to have different conjuros depending on what its conjuro circle has contributed.

If the elemental vessel is destroyed, all members of the conjuro circle regain the conjuro slots they contributed to the criatura. The arcane innate conjuros shown below represent a typical conjuro list for an elemental vessel, but each elemental vessel is likely to have different conjuros depending on what its conjuro circle has contributed.

action->Dispel Vulnerability.name: Dispel Vulnerability
action->Dispel Vulnerability.description: Siempre que a criatura successfully counteracts one of its conjuros, the vessel permanently loses access to that conjuro y sufre daño equal to 4 × the conjuro's rank. The conjuro circle member who contributed that conjuro regains access to their contributed conjuro slot.

action->Inhabit Vessel.name: Inhabit Vessel
action->Inhabit Vessel.description: Any member of the elemental vessel's conjuro circle can spend 3 actions to mentally inhabit the vessel durante 1 asalto. While they inhabit the vessel, the inhabiter controls the vessel's actions, y the vessel uses the inhabiter's INTELLIGENCE, Wisdom, y Charisma modifiers for all checks. Only one criatura can inhabit an elemental vessel at a time.

action->Internal Spell Strike.name: Internal Spell Golpe
action->Internal Spell Strike.description: The elemental vessel targets an engulfed criatura with one of its conjuros. The conjuro must have a range of touch.

Push 10 pies

Waxworks Onslaught Trap.name: Waxworks Onslaught Trap
Waxworks Onslaught Trap.description: Four enorme tubs containing congealed wax, enchanted a melt y envelop unwary intruders, cada sit atop un frio fuego.
Waxworks Onslaught Trap.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:43|name:Drain Wax from a Tub|traits:action:disable-a-device] (maestro) to drain the wax from a tub or @Check[athletics|dc:45|name:Push Through Wax|traits:action:force-open] (maestro) to push through the wax blocking a sealed door y escape (other criaturas must push their own way through, as the wax reseals)
Waxworks Onslaught Trap.hpDetails: to destroy a tub y prevent it from making any further attacks; Door Seal Hardness 18; Door Seal HP 72 (UR 36) to destroy the wax on a sealed door y allow anyone to escape through the door
Waxworks Onslaught Trap.reset: La trampa deactivates y resets after 1 hora. At that time, the wax in the tubs cools y congeals, y any wax elsewhere in the room magically goes back into the tubs.
Waxworks Onslaught Trap.routine: (4 actions) La trampa loses 1 action each turn per drained or destroyed tub. On each action, a different tub spews hot wax at a random criatura in the room, dealing @Damage[3d12[fire]|options:area-damage] daño to el objetivo y all adjacent criaturas (@Check[reflex|dc:35|basic|options:area-effect] salvacion). Con un fallo o fallo critico, the criatura is also encased in hot wax. A criatura that starts its turn encased in wax takes @Damage[8d12[fire]] daño y is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} until it [[/act escape dc=35]]{Escapes} the hardening wax. Each turn it remains encased, the daño dealt by the hot wax decreases by 2d12 but the DC to Escape increases by 2 (minimum 0 daño, maximum DC 43). A criatura that can't get free from the wax might suffocate.

action->Seal Room.name: Seal Room
action->Seal Room.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura comes a 5 pies o menos of a tub

Efecto El fires beneath the vats blaze to life, magically melting the wax in the tubs. The tubs emit gouts of wax over the room's exits, sealing them shut. La trampa then rolls initiative.

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.AWvNPE4U0kEJSL1T]

Any criatura taking @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistente Bleed Dano} is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} against the Skinner's attacks. When attacking an desprevenido criatura, the Skinner inflige an additional 2d6 daño de precision.

action->Chain Expert.name: Chain Expert
action->Chain Expert.description: El Skinner puede effectively wield abnormally long spiked chains y puede do so using solo one hand.

action->Chain Up.name: Chain Up
action->Chain Up.description:
Requisitos El Skinner has an adjacent criatura grabbed with her spiked chain

Efecto El Skinner attempts an @Check[athletics|defense:reflex] check against the grabbed criatura's Reflex save DC. Con un exito, the Skinner knots her chain around the grabbed criatura, which becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Neutralizado} (Escape DC = 10 + the result of the Skinner's ATHLETICS check); on a critical success, the criatura also falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}.

Regardless of whether the Skinner succeeds, she drops the chain.

action->Flay.name: Flay
action->Flay.description: Siempre que the Skinner makes a successful cleaver Golpe against a grabbed criatura, she also inflige @Damage[1d6[bleed]] (or @Damage[2d6[bleed]] on a impacto critico).

action->Hook and Flay.name: Enganchar y desollar
action->Hook and Flay.description:
Requisitos El Skinner has a criatura grabbed with her spiked chain

Efecto El Skinner pulls the criatura into the nearest open adjacent square y makes a cleaver Golpe against the criatura.

weapon->+2 Greater Striking Longsword.name: +2 Greater Striking Longsword
weapon->+2 Greater Striking Longsword.description: Las espadas largas pueden tener uno o dos filos. Sus hojas son pesadas y miden entre 3 y 4 pies de longitud.

armor->+2 Resilient Full Plate.name: +2 Resilient Full Plate
armor->+2 Resilient Full Plate.description: La armadura de placas consta de placas entrelazadas que envuelven casi todo el cuerpo en un caparazon de acero. Es cara y pesada, y quien la lleva suele necesitar ayuda para ponersela correctamente, pero proporciona una de las mejores defensas que puede ofrecer una armadura. Un juego de esta armadura incluye una capa inferior de armadura acolchada y un par de guanteletes.

equipment->Ring of Sustenance.description: Este polished wooden ring constantly refreshes tu body y mind. No necesitas need to eat or drink while wearing it, y necesitas only 2 hours of sleep per day to gain the benefits of 8 hours of sleep. A ring of sustenance doesn't function until it's been worn y invested continuously for a week. Removing it resets this interval.

consumable->Whisper Briolette.description:
Activar 2 imaginar

Requisitos Estas an experto in STEALTH

Este teardrop-shaped gemstone has triangular facets y looks suitable for fancy attire, although close inspection shows that it's hollow. When it's activated, puedes instantly impart up to 1 minuto of speech (roughly 150 words) telepathically to any criaturas tu elige a 100 pies o menos. Puedes impart this instantaneous telepathic message to criaturas that tu perceive y criaturas @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido} to tu, but puedes't do so to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{No detectado} criaturas. Once used, the whisper briolette becomes unusable y subtly vanishes within the next few minutes, rather than crumbling to dust.

action->Attack of Opportunity.name: Ataque de oportunidad
action->Attack of Opportunity.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura al alcance del monstruo usa una accion de manipular o una accion de movimiento, realiza un ataque a distancia o abandona una casilla durante una accion de movimiento que esta usando.

Efecto El monstruo intenta un Golpe cuerpo a cuerpo contra la criatura desencadenante. Si el ataque es un impacto critico y el desencadenante fue una accion de manipular, el monstruo interrumpe esa accion. Este Golpe no cuenta para el penalizador por ataques multiples del monstruo, y su penalizador por ataques multiples no se aplica a este Golpe.

action->Tactical Aura.name: Tactical Aura
action->Tactical Aura.description: 60 pies. Allies of lower level than Wynsal in the aura gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.hFtNbo1LKYCoDy2O]{Attack of Opportunity} reaction. Allies who already have the Attack of Opportunity reaction can use it when a criatura within their reach uses a concentrate action, in addition to normal triggers, y they disrupt a triggering concentrate action on a impacto critico.

action->Demanding Orders.name: Demanding Orders
action->Demanding Orders.description: Wynsal ordena a sus aliados que actuen. Los aliados a 120 pies o menos que oyen y entienden su orden quedan @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Acelerado 1} durante 1 asalto y pueden usar esta accion adicional para Zancajear, Golpear o Dar un paso.

action->Determination.name: Determinación
action->Determination.description: Wynsal either ends a nonpermanent condicion affecting him or counteracts a nonpermanent conjuro affecting him (counteract rank 17th, counteract check [[/r 1d20+30 #Counteract]]{+30}). Este doesn't remove daño a Puntos de Golpe or prevent the conjuro or effect from affecting others. It can't remove an ongoing affliction or condiciones from a situation outside his control (such as being grappled or flanked).

action->Formation Attack.name: Formation Attack
action->Formation Attack.description: Wynsal inflige 3d8 daño adicional to any criatura that's within reach of at least two of his allies.

action->Hampering Strike.name: Hampering Golpe
action->Hampering Strike.description: Un enemigo que sufre daño del Golpe cuerpo a cuerpo de Wynsal queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} durante 1 asalto. Si ya estaba ralentizado, el valor de la condicion ralentizado aumenta en 1.

action->Consume Flesh.name: Consumir carne
action->Consume Flesh.description:
Requisitos El ghoul is adjacent to the corpse of an evil or chaotic criatura that died within the last hour.

Efecto El ghoul devours a chunk of the corpse y regains @Damage[6d6[healing]] Puntos de Golpe. It can regain Puntos de Golpe from any given corpse only once.

action->Ghoul Fever.name: Ghoul Fever
action->Ghoul Fever.description:
Tirada de salvacion @Check[fortitude|dc:27]

Etapa 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 día)

Etapa 2 @Damage[2d6[void]] daño y regains half as many Puntos de Golpe from all healing (1 día)

Etapa 3 as stage 2 (1 día)

Etapa 4 @Damage[2d6[void]] daño y gains no benefit from healing (1 día)

Etapa 5 as stage 4 (1 día)

Etapa 6 dead, y rises as a zeal-damned ghoul the next midnight.

action->Paralysis.name: Paralysis
action->Paralysis.description: Any living, non-elf criatura hit by a ghoul's attack debe tener exito en una @Check[fortitude|dc:27] salvacion or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado}. It can intentar una new save at the end of each of its turns, y the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.

action->Swift Leap.name: Salto veloz
action->Swift Leap.description: The ghoul jumps up to half its Velocidad. Este movement no desencadena reacciones.

spell->Veil.name: Velo
spell->Veil.description:
Tu disguise the targets as other criaturas of the same body shape y roughly similar height (within 6 inches) y weight (within 50 pounds). The disguise can hide the targets' identities or let them appear to be of another ancestry, but it's not precise enough to impersonate specific individuals. The conjuro doesn't change voice, scent, or mannerisms. Tu elige the disguise for each target; for example, tu could make one target appear to be a dwarf y another an elf. Casting veil counts as setting up a disguise for the purpose of the Impersonate action. It allows el objetivo to ignore any circumstance penalties they might take for being disguised as dissimilar criaturas, y it gives the targets a +4 bonificador de estado to DECEPTION checks to prevent others from seeing through their disguises, y add their level even if untrained. Puedes Dismiss any or all of these disguises.

Heightened (5th) The conjuro also disguises the targets' voices y scents; it gains the auditory rasgo.

Heightened (7th) The targets can appear as any criatura of the same size, even specific individuals. Debes have seen an individual to reproduce their appearance. The conjuro also disguises the targets' voices y scents; it gains the auditory rasgo.

spell->Geas (Ritual).name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Q690d3mw3TUrKX7E]
Geas (ritual)
spell->Geas (Ritual).target: 1 criatura de nivel no superior al doble del nivel del ritual geas

armor->Breastplate.description: Aunque se la denomina coraza, este tipo de armadura consta de varias piezas de armadura de placas o semiplacas que protegen el torso, el pecho, el cuello y, a veces, las caderas y la parte inferior de las piernas. Proporciona parte de la proteccion de una armadura de placas sin renunciar tanto a la flexibilidad y la velocidad.

ammo->Sling Bullets.name: Balas de honda
ammo->Sling Bullets.description: Estos are small metal balls, typically either iron or lead, designed to be used as ammunition in slings.

action->Little Favors.name: Little Favors
action->Little Favors.description: Each time a criatura willingly performs a service, quest, or task for the zealborn, the criatura sufre un cumulative -1 penalizador de estado a las tiradas de salvacion against the zealborn's mental conjuros y abilities (maximum -4).

action->Rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenecimiento
action->Rejuvenation.description: When a zealborn is destroyed, it re-forms, fully healed, near a follower of its choice in [[/gmr 1d10 #days]]{1d10 days}. For the purposes of rejuvenation, a follower is defined as an intelligent criatura who's well acquainted with the zealborn y is a true believer in the zealborn's mission, not merely a lukewarm supporter. A zealborn can be permanently destroyed only if they have no current followers or can be convinced to end their own life.

action->Zealous Restoration.name: Zealous Restoration
action->Zealous Restoration.description: A zealborn can't regain Puntos de Golpe through resting or curación de vacío; they feed only on the idealism of their supporters, regaining 10 Puntos de Golpe per day for each criatura under the effects of a geas cast by the zealborn. Las criaturas under a zealborn's geas have their maximum HP reduced by 10 each day until they are burned away to a husk y perish. After 24 horas, such criaturas rise as zeal-damned ghouls under the zealborn's control. Zeal-damned ghouls eat only the flesh of evil or chaotic criaturas y deal an additional 1d6 spirit y 1d6 daño de vacio with their attacks.

action->Dubious Shifting.name: Dubious Shifting
action->Dubious Shifting.description:
The zrukbat assumes the shape of any Small object or ornamentation, although the zrukbat's mimicked objects usually have unrealistic or suspicious quirks.

Este doesn't change the zrukbat's size but can alter their coloration y visual appearance.

They have an automatic result of 23 on DECEPTION checks y DCs to pass as the mimicked object.

action->Go for the Eyes.name: Go for the Eyes
action->Go for the Eyes.description:
The zrukbat flies up to its Velocidad y makes a claw Golpe at the end of its move.

If the claw attack hits, el objetivo debe tener exito en una @Check[fortitude|dc:15] tirada de salvacion or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} durante 1 asalto (or blinded durante 1 minuto on a critical failure). If the Golpe was a impacto critico, la esencia del objetivo save result is one degree of success worse.
